title: The Book of Ezekiel Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Ezekiel — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.decoded: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Chebar River, the sky opened and I saw visions from God.

verses.kjv: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.decoded: This was on the fifth day of the month, during the fifth year that King Jehoiachin was held captive.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
verses.decoded: God’s message came clearly to Ezekiel, a priest and son of Buzi, while he was in Babylon near the Chebar River; God's power was upon him.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.decoded: I saw a storm coming from the north—a huge cloud with fire swirling inside it, shining brightly with a glowing amber color in the middle of the fire.

verses.kjv: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.decoded: From the center of this appeared four living beings, each looking like a human.

verses.kjv: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.decoded: Each creature had four faces and four wings.

verses.kjv: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.decoded: Their feet were straight, with soles like those of a calf, shining like polished bronze.

verses.kjv: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.decoded: They had human hands under their wings on all four sides, and each had faces and wings.

verses.kjv: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.decoded: Their wings touched each other, and they did not turn as they moved; they went straight ahead.

verses.kjv: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.decoded: Each had four faces: a human face, a lion’s face on the right, an ox’s face on the left, and an eagle’s face.

verses.kjv: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.decoded: Their faces were as described, and their wings were raised up; two wings touched each other, and two covered their bodies.

verses.kjv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
verses.decoded: They moved straight forward wherever the Spirit directed, without turning as they moved.

verses.kjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.decoded: The creatures looked like burning coals or glowing lamps, moving up and down among them; the fire was bright and lightning flashed from it.

verses.kjv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.decoded: The creatures moved quickly back and forth like flashes of lightning.

verses.kjv: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.decoded: As I watched the creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each of them, and the wheel had four faces.

verses.kjv: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.decoded: The wheels looked like they were made of beryl, a bright, greenish-blue stone. All four wheels looked the same, and each looked like a wheel within a wheel.

verses.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
verses.decoded: When the wheels moved, they went straight in any of the four directions without turning as they moved.

verses.kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
verses.decoded: The rims of the wheels were very tall and awe-inspiring, and all around each rim were many eyes.

verses.kjv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.decoded: Whenever the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them.

verses.kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.decoded: The wheels moved wherever the spirit wanted to go; the spirit controlled their movement. The wheels rose beside the living creatures because the spirit of the creatures was also in the wheels.

verses.kjv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.decoded: When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stopped, the wheels stopped; when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them, because the spirit of the creatures was in the wheels.

verses.kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.decoded: Above the heads of the living creatures was something like a vast, awesome crystal dome, shining like ice or crystal.

verses.kjv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.decoded: Under the crystal dome, the creatures’ wings stretched out straight, touching each other. Each creature had two wings covering its body on one side and two wings covering it on the other side.

verses.kjv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.decoded: When the creatures moved, the sound of their wings was like the roar of mighty waters, like the voice of God, like the sound of an army. When they stopped, they folded their wings.

verses.kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
verses.decoded: When the creatures stood still and folded their wings, a voice came from the crystal dome above their heads.

verses.kjv: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.decoded: Above the crystal dome was something like a throne made of sapphire stone, and sitting on the throne was a figure that looked like a man.

verses.kjv: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.decoded: The figure glowed like amber and looked like fire burning all around from the waist up and down, shining brightly all around.

verses.kjv: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.decoded: Around the figure was a brightness like a rainbow shining through clouds on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell face down and heard someone speaking.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Son of man, stand up on your feet, and I will speak to you.'

verses.kjv: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.decoded: The Spirit entered me as He spoke, and He helped me stand so I could listen to Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, I am sending you to the people of Israel, a rebellious nation that has defied me. They and their ancestors have sinned against me up to this very day.'

verses.kjv: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: They are stubborn and hard-hearted children. I am sending you to them, and you must tell them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says.'

verses.kjv: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
verses.decoded: Whether they listen or refuse to listen, because they are rebellious, they will know that a prophet has been among them.

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: Son of man, don’t be afraid of them or their threats, even though you face dangers like thorns and scorpions living among them. Don’t be discouraged by their attitude, even though they are rebellious.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
verses.decoded: You must speak my words to them whether they listen or not, because they are very rebellious.

verses.kjv: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
verses.decoded: But you, son of man, listen to me: don’t be rebellious like them. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.

verses.kjv: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
verses.decoded: I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me holding a scroll.

verses.kjv: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
verses.decoded: He unrolled it in front of me, and it was written on both sides with words of sorrow, mourning, and disaster.

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then he said to me, 'Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll and go speak to the people of Israel.'

verses.kjv: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.decoded: So I opened my mouth, and he made me eat the scroll.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you; fill your stomach with it.' So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
verses.decoded: Then he said, 'Son of man, go to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.'

verses.kjv: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
verses.decoded: You are not being sent to people who speak a foreign language or have a difficult tongue, but to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
verses.decoded: Not to many people who speak a foreign language you cannot understand. If I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

verses.kjv: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
verses.decoded: But the people of Israel will not listen to you because they do not listen to me; they are stubborn and hard-hearted.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.decoded: I have made your face strong to face theirs, and your forehead strong to face their stubbornness.

verses.kjv: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: I have made your forehead as hard as diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or discouraged by their attitude, even though they are rebellious.

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Son of man, take all my words to heart and listen carefully to what I say.'

verses.kjv: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.decoded: Go to the exiles, your own people, and speak to them. Tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' whether they listen or refuse.

verses.kjv: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rushing sound saying, 'Praise the glory of the LORD from his place.'

verses.kjv: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
verses.decoded: I also heard the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching each other, the sound of the wheels beside them, and a loud rushing noise.

verses.kjv: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
verses.decoded: The Spirit lifted me up and took me away. I went in bitterness and anger, but the LORD’s hand was strong upon me.

verses.kjv: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.decoded: I came to the exiles at Telabib by the Chebar River. I sat with them and was amazed among them for seven days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: After seven days, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.decoded: Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the people of Israel. Listen carefully to what I say, and warn them on my behalf.

verses.kjv: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.decoded: If I tell a wicked person, ‘You will die,’ and you don’t warn them or try to stop them from their evil ways to save their life, that wicked person will die because of their sin—but I will hold you responsible for their death.

verses.kjv: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.decoded: But if you warn the wicked and they refuse to turn from their evil ways, they will die because of their sin—but you will have saved yourself.

verses.kjv: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumbling-block before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.decoded: If a righteous person turns away from their righteousness and sins, and I cause something to trip them up, they will die. If you don’t warn them, they will die in their sin, and their past good deeds won’t be remembered—but I will hold you responsible for their death.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.decoded: But if you warn a righteous person not to sin, and they listen and don’t sin, they will live because they were warned—and you will have saved yourself.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s power came upon me, and He said, ‘Get up and go out into the open field; I will speak with you there.’

verses.kjv: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.decoded: So I got up and went out into the plain. There I saw the glory of the LORD standing there, just like the glory I had seen by the Chebar River. I fell face down.

verses.kjv: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit came into me and made me stand up. He spoke to me and said, ‘Go inside your house and shut the door behind you.’

verses.kjv: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
verses.decoded: Son of man, you will be tied up with ropes and bound so you won’t be able to go out among the people.

verses.kjv: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so you won’t be able to speak. You won’t be able to warn them because they are a rebellious people.

verses.kjv: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says.’ Whoever listens, let them listen; whoever refuses, let them refuse, because they are a rebellious people.

verses.kjv: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: Son of man, take a clay tablet and place it in front of you. Draw a picture of the city of Jerusalem on it.

verses.kjv: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
verses.decoded: Pretend to lay siege to the city by building a fort and a ramp against it. Surround it with camps and battering rams all around.

verses.kjv: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: Also take an iron plate and place it like an iron wall between you and the city. Face the city as if you are laying siege to it. This will be a sign to Israel.

verses.kjv: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
verses.decoded: Lie on your left side and carry the sins of Israel on that side. You will lie there for a number of days equal to the number of years their sins last.

verses.kjv: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: I have assigned you to carry their sins for 390 days, each day representing a year of Israel’s guilt.

verses.kjv: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
verses.decoded: After that, lie on your right side for 40 days to carry Judah’s sins, with each day representing a year.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
verses.decoded: Face Jerusalem openly, expose your arm, and prophesy against the city.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
verses.decoded: I will bind you so you cannot turn from one side to the other until you finish the days of your siege.

verses.kjv: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
verses.decoded: Gather wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, mix them together, and bake bread from them. Eat this bread for 390 days while you lie on your side.

verses.kjv: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
verses.decoded: You will eat only 20 shekels (about 7 ounces) of this bread each day, eating it sparingly.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
verses.decoded: You will drink only a sixth of a hin (about a pint) of water each day, drinking it sparingly.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
verses.decoded: You will bake your bread as barley cakes, using human dung as fuel in front of others.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, this is how Israel will eat defiled bread among the nations where I will scatter them.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
verses.decoded: I said, ‘Lord GOD, I have kept myself pure; I have never eaten anything dead or torn by animals, nor anything unclean.’

verses.kjv: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow’s dung for man’s dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
verses.decoded: The LORD replied, ‘I will let you use cow dung instead of human dung to bake your bread.’

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
verses.decoded: Then he said to me, 'Son of man, watch this: I will break the supply of bread in Jerusalem. People will have to measure their bread carefully and eat it with great caution; they will also have to ration their water and drink it with fear and shock.'

verses.kjv: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
verses.decoded: This will cause them to lack bread and water, making them terrified of each other, and they will waste away because of their sins.

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber’s razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.
verses.decoded: Son of man, take a sharp knife, like a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then use scales to weigh and divide the hair.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.decoded: Burn a third of the hair in the middle of the city after the siege ends; cut a third with a knife; and scatter the last third to the wind. I will then bring sword against them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
verses.decoded: Take a small number of the hair and tie it into the folds of your clothing.

verses.kjv: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then take some of those tied in your clothes and throw them into the fire to burn, because a fire will spread through all Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD says: This is Jerusalem. I placed it in the center among the surrounding nations and lands.

verses.kjv: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
verses.decoded: But Jerusalem has turned my laws into evil more than the surrounding nations and countries. They rejected my laws and did not follow them.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
verses.decoded: So the Lord GOD says: Because you have grown more numerous than the surrounding nations but have not followed my laws or judgments, nor acted like the nations around you,

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
verses.decoded: I, the Lord GOD, am against you and will carry out judgment within you, publicly before the nations.

verses.kjv: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
verses.decoded: I will do things to you I have never done before and will never do again because of all your terrible sins.

verses.kjv: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
verses.decoded: Because of this, fathers will eat their sons and sons will eat their fathers within you. I will judge you and scatter the survivors to all the winds.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, because you have defiled my sanctuary with your disgusting sins, I will reduce your numbers; I will not show mercy or pity.

verses.kjv: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.decoded: One-third of you will die from disease and famine inside the city; one-third will be killed by the sword around you; and one-third I will scatter to the winds, pursuing them with the sword.

verses.kjv: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
verses.decoded: My anger will be fulfilled; my fury will rest on them, and I will be satisfied. They will know I, the LORD, have spoken out of zeal when I carry out my anger against them.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
verses.decoded: I will make you desolate and a disgrace among the surrounding nations, visible to everyone who passes by.

verses.kjv: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: It will be a disgrace, a mockery, a lesson, and a shock to the nations around you when I bring judgment on you with anger, fury, and harsh punishment. I, the LORD, have declared it.

verses.kjv: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
verses.decoded: I will send deadly famine arrows against them to bring their destruction, and I will send them to destroy you. I will make the famine worse for you and break your source of food.

verses.kjv: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: I will send famine and wild animals to take away your people; disease and violence will sweep through you, and I will bring war against you. This is the declaration of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to the mountains of Israel and speak a prophecy against them,

verses.kjv: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.decoded: Say to the mountains of Israel, 'Listen to the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains, hills, rivers, and valleys: I myself will bring a sword against you and destroy your places of worship.'

verses.kjv: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
verses.decoded: Your altars will be left empty and ruined, your idols will be smashed, and I will throw the bodies of your dead in front of your idols.

verses.kjv: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
verses.decoded: I will place the dead bodies of the people of Israel in front of their idols and scatter their bones around their altars.

verses.kjv: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
verses.decoded: All your towns will be destroyed, and your places of worship will be deserted. Your altars will be ruined, your idols smashed and destroyed, your images cut down, and your sinful practices ended.

verses.kjv: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: The dead will fall among you, and you will realize that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
verses.decoded: But I will leave a small group alive so that some will survive the sword and live among the nations where you will be scattered.

verses.kjv: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
verses.decoded: Those who survive will remember me among the nations where they are taken captive, because I am hurt by their unfaithful hearts that have turned away from me and their eyes that chase after idols. They will hate themselves for the evil they have done in all their sinful acts.

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
verses.decoded: They will understand that I am the LORD and that I did not threaten to bring this disaster without meaning it.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: Strike your hand and stomp your foot and say, 'Woe to all the evil sins of Israel! They will fall by the sword, famine, and disease.'

verses.kjv: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
verses.decoded: Those far away will die from disease; those nearby will be killed by the sword; and those who remain and are trapped will die from hunger. This is how I will carry out my anger against them.

verses.kjv: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
verses.decoded: Then you will know that I am the LORD when the dead bodies lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, mountain top, under every green tree and thick oak—the places where they burned incense to their idols.

verses.kjv: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will reach out against them and make their land more desolate than the wilderness near Diblath, destroying all their homes. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.decoded: Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to the land of Israel: The end has come to every part of the land.

verses.kjv: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.decoded: The end has come for you, and I will bring my anger against you. I will judge you according to your actions and repay you for all your detestable sins.

verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will not show mercy or pity. I will repay you for your actions, and your sins will be evident among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: A disaster, a terrible disaster, has arrived.

verses.kjv: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
verses.decoded: The end has come, the end has come! It is ready and waiting for you; look, it has arrived.

verses.kjv: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
verses.decoded: The morning has come for you who live in the land; the time has come, and the day of disaster is near. There will be no more echoes from the mountains.

verses.kjv: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
verses.decoded: Soon I will pour out my anger on you and complete my punishment. I will judge you based on your actions and repay you for all your sins.

verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
verses.decoded: I will not show mercy or pity. I will repay you according to your actions and sins among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD who punishes.

verses.kjv: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
verses.decoded: Look, the day has come! The morning has arrived; the punishment rod has blossomed, and pride has grown.

verses.kjv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
verses.decoded: Violence has become a tool of wickedness. None of them will survive, not even their numbers or their people. There will be no mourning for them.

verses.kjv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.decoded: The time has come; the day is near. Buyers should not celebrate, and sellers should not grieve, because God's anger is against everyone.

verses.kjv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.decoded: The seller will not get back what was sold, even if still alive, because the vision affects everyone, and none will escape. No one will continue to strengthen themselves in their sinful ways.

verses.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.decoded: The trumpet has sounded to prepare everyone, but no one goes to fight because my anger is against all the people.

verses.kjv: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.decoded: The sword is outside, and inside there is disease and famine. Those in the fields will die by the sword, and those in the cities will be destroyed by famine and disease.

verses.kjv: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.decoded: Those who survive will flee to the mountains like doves from the valleys, all of them grieving, each one because of their own sin.

verses.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
verses.decoded: Everyone will be weak and powerless; their knees will shake like water.

verses.kjv: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.decoded: They will put on sackcloth to mourn; terror will overwhelm them, shame will be on every face, and their heads will be bald from grief.

verses.kjv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.decoded: They will throw their silver into the streets and lose their gold; their wealth will not save them on the day of the Lord’s anger. Their riches will not satisfy them or ease their hunger because their greed caused their sin.

verses.kjv: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
verses.decoded: Though he placed beautiful ornaments in a place of honor, they filled it with idols and detestable things. Because of this, I have rejected it and made it unclean for them.

verses.kjv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.decoded: I will hand it over to foreigners and wicked people who will loot and defile it.

verses.kjv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
verses.decoded: I will turn away from them, and they will defile my sanctuary because thieves will break in and dishonor it.

verses.kjv: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.decoded: Prepare to be bound, because the land is filled with murder and the city is full of violence.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will bring the worst foreigners who will take over their homes. I will end the pride of the powerful, and their sacred places will be defiled.

verses.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
verses.decoded: Destruction is coming, and when they look for peace, they will find none.

verses.kjv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.decoded: Trouble will pile on trouble, and rumors will spread. People will seek guidance from prophets, but the priests will lose the law, and the elders will lose their wisdom.

verses.kjv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: The king will grieve, the prince will be in despair, and the people will be shaken. I will punish them as they deserve, and they will understand that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
verses.decoded: In the sixth year, on the sixth month, on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house with the elders of Judah before me, the power of the Lord God came upon me.

verses.kjv: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
verses.decoded: I looked and saw something like fire: from his waist down it looked like fire, and from his waist up it looked like glowing brightness, like amber.

verses.kjv: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.decoded: A hand reached out and grabbed me by my hair, and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me in a vision to Jerusalem, to the inner gate facing north, where the idol that causes God’s jealousy was placed.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.decoded: There I saw the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it earlier in the plain.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Son of man, look toward the north.' I looked, and there at the north gate of the altar was the idol that causes God’s jealousy.

verses.kjv: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, do you see the terrible sins the people of Israel are committing here, causing me to abandon my sanctuary? But look again, and you will see even worse sins.'

verses.kjv: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
verses.decoded: He took me to the courtyard gate, and when I looked, I saw a hole in the wall.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, dig into the wall.' When I dug, I found a door.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
verses.decoded: He told me, 'Go inside and see the evil sins they are doing here.'

verses.kjv: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
verses.decoded: I went in and saw all kinds of crawling creatures, disgusting animals, and all the idols of Israel painted all around the walls.

verses.kjv: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.decoded: Seventy elders of Israel stood before the idols, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan, each holding a censer with incense rising thickly.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel do in secret, each in their own rooms with their idols? They say, “The Lord doesn’t see us; He has abandoned the land.”'

verses.kjv: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Look again, and you will see even worse sins they are committing.'

verses.kjv: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.decoded: He took me to the north gate of the Lord’s temple, and there I saw women sitting and mourning for Tammuz.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Have you seen this, son of man? Look again, and you will see even worse sins than these.'

verses.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
verses.decoded: He took me into the inner courtyard of the Lord’s temple, and there, at the entrance of the temple, between the porch and the altar, about twenty-five men were standing with their backs to the temple and facing east, worshiping the sun in that direction.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
verses.decoded: Then he asked me, 'Son of man, have you seen this? Do you think it’s a small matter that the people of Judah are committing these terrible sins here? They have filled the land with violence and have deliberately angered me. Look, they even smell the incense as they worship.'

verses.kjv: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I will act in anger; I will not show mercy or pity. Even if they shout loudly to me, I will not listen to them.

verses.kjv: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
verses.decoded: He shouted loudly in my ear, saying, 'Tell those responsible for the city to come near, each carrying their weapon of destruction.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
verses.decoded: Then six men came from the direction of the upper gate facing north, each carrying a weapon for killing. Among them was a man dressed in linen with a writer’s inkhorn at his side. They entered and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;
verses.decoded: The glory of the God of Israel rose up from above the cherub where it had been, to the entrance of the temple. Then God called to the man dressed in linen with the writer’s inkhorn.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to him, 'Go through the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who mourn and lament over all the evil done there.'

verses.kjv: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
verses.decoded: To the others he said, so I heard, 'Follow him through the city and kill without mercy; do not show pity or spare anyone.'

verses.kjv: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
verses.decoded: Kill everyone—old and young, women, and children—but do not harm anyone with the mark. Begin the killing at the temple. They started with the elders in front of the temple.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'Pollute the temple by filling its courts with the dead bodies.' Then they went out and killed people throughout the city.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: While they were killing, I was left alone. I fell face down and cried out, 'Sovereign LORD, will you destroy the remaining people of Israel as you pour out your anger on Jerusalem?'

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'The sin of Israel and Judah is very great. The land is soaked with blood, and the city is full of corruption because they say, "The LORD has abandoned the land; he does not see what happens."'

verses.kjv: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
verses.decoded: I will not show mercy or pity; I will repay them for their actions.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
verses.decoded: Then the man dressed in linen with the writer’s inkhorn reported, 'I have done exactly as you commanded.'

verses.kjv: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.decoded: I looked up, and above the heads of the cherubim there was something like a sapphire stone, which looked like a throne.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
verses.decoded: God told the man dressed in linen, 'Go between the wheels, under the cherub, and take some burning coals from between the cherubim. Then scatter them over the city.' The man did this while I watched.

verses.kjv: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.decoded: The cherubim were standing on the right side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner courtyard.

verses.kjv: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
verses.decoded: Then the glory of the Lord rose from the cherub and stood above the temple entrance. The temple was filled with a cloud, and the courtyard was bright with the Lord’s glory.

verses.kjv: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
verses.decoded: The sound of the cherubim’s wings could be heard all the way to the outer courtyard, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
verses.decoded: After God told the man in linen to take fire from between the wheels and cherubim, the man went in and stood beside the wheels.

verses.kjv: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
verses.decoded: One cherub reached out his hand from between the cherubim, took some fire from between them, and gave it to the man in linen. The man took it and left.

verses.kjv: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
verses.decoded: Under the wings of the cherubim, I saw something that looked like a human hand.

verses.kjv: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.decoded: I saw four wheels beside the cherubim—one wheel next to each cherub. The wheels looked like they were made of beryl, a bright, shining stone.

verses.kjv: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
verses.decoded: Each of the four wheels looked the same, as if one wheel was inside another wheel.

verses.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.decoded: When the wheels moved, they went straight in any direction without turning; they followed wherever the heads pointed without changing direction.

verses.kjv: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
verses.decoded: Their entire bodies, backs, hands, wings, and the wheels were covered with eyes all around.

verses.kjv: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
verses.decoded: I heard the wheels being called 'wheel' or 'galgal' (which means wheel).

verses.kjv: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.decoded: Each had four faces: the face of a cherub, a man, a lion, and an eagle.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.decoded: The cherubim rose up. This is the living creature I saw earlier by the Chebar River.

verses.kjv: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.decoded: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved alongside them. When the cherubim raised their wings to lift off from the ground, the wheels stayed right beside them and did not turn away.

verses.kjv: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.decoded: When the cherubim stopped, the wheels stopped too; when the cherubim lifted off, the wheels lifted as well, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.kjv: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.decoded: Then the glory of the Lord left the entrance of the temple and stood above the cherubim.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.decoded: The cherubim raised their wings and lifted off from the ground right before me. As they left, the wheels were beside them. They all stopped at the east gate of the Lord’s temple, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.kjv: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
verses.decoded: This is the living creature I saw under the God of Israel by the Chebar River, and I realized they were cherubim.

verses.kjv: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.decoded: Each one had four faces and four wings, and under their wings were hands that looked like human hands.

verses.kjv: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.decoded: Their faces looked exactly like the ones I saw by the Chebar River, with the same appearance. Each one moved straight ahead without turning.

verses.kjv: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.decoded: The Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of the LORD's temple, which faces east. There, at the gate's entrance, I saw twenty-five men, including Jaazaniah son of Azur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
verses.decoded: Then he said to me, 'Son of man, these are the men who plan evil and give bad advice in this city.'

verses.kjv: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
verses.decoded: They say, 'The danger is not near; let's build houses.' They see the city as a cooking pot and themselves as the meat inside it.

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, prophesy against them. Speak out against them.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
verses.decoded: The Spirit of the LORD came upon me and said, 'Speak, this is what the LORD says: This is what you, house of Israel, have said, because I know every thought you have.'

verses.kjv: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.decoded: You have increased the number of dead in this city and filled its streets with corpses.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: The dead you have left in the city are like the meat in a cooking pot, and the city is the pot itself. But I will bring you out from among them.

verses.kjv: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You have been afraid of the sword, so I will bring the sword against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.decoded: I will take you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners, who will punish you.

verses.kjv: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You will die by the sword. I will judge you at Israel's borders, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
verses.decoded: This city will no longer be your cooking pot, and you will no longer be the meat inside it. Instead, I will judge you at Israel's borders.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
verses.decoded: Then you will know that I am the LORD, because you have not followed my laws or obeyed my rules. Instead, you have acted like the nations around you.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
verses.decoded: While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. I fell face down and shouted, 'Ah, Sovereign LORD, will you completely destroy the remaining people of Israel?'

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
verses.decoded: Son of man, your relatives—your own people and all of Israel—are the ones the people of Jerusalem have rejected, saying, 'Stay away from the LORD; this land belongs to us.'

verses.kjv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
verses.decoded: So tell them, this is what the Lord GOD says: Even though I have sent them far away among the nations and scattered them across many lands, I will still be like a small place of safety for them wherever they go.

verses.kjv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
verses.decoded: So tell them, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather you from among the nations and bring you back from all the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.decoded: When they return, they will remove all the disgusting idols and sinful things from the land.

verses.kjv: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verses.decoded: I will give them a united heart and put a new spirit inside them. I will remove their hard, stubborn hearts and give them soft, responsive hearts instead.

verses.kjv: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.decoded: So they will follow my laws, obey my commands, and live by them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.kjv: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: But for those whose hearts follow their sinful desires and idols, I will repay them according to their actions, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.decoded: Then the cherubim raised their wings, and the wheels beside them moved; and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
verses.decoded: The glory of the LORD left the middle of the city and stood on the mountain east of the city.

verses.kjv: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit lifted me up and took me in a vision by God’s Spirit to the land of the Chaldeans, to the people in exile. The vision I had seen left me.

verses.kjv: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
verses.decoded: Then I spoke to the exiles about everything the LORD had shown me.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: Son of man, you live among a rebellious people who have eyes but do not see, and ears but do not hear, because they are rebellious.

verses.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, get your belongings ready to move and carry them out during the day where everyone can see you. Move from your home to another place openly, hoping they might pay attention, even though they are rebellious.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
verses.decoded: You will carry your belongings out during the day in front of them, like someone preparing to be taken into exile. Then, at evening, you will leave openly, just like those being led away into captivity.

verses.kjv: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
verses.decoded: Dig through the wall right where they can see you, and carry your belongings out through the opening.

verses.kjv: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will carry your belongings on your shoulder at dusk, covering your face so you cannot see the ground, because I have made you a sign for the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.decoded: I obeyed as I was told: I took my belongings out during the day like someone preparing for exile, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. Then, at dusk, I carried my belongings on my shoulder where everyone could see me.

verses.kjv: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The next morning, the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.decoded: Son of man, hasn’t the rebellious people of Israel asked you, 'What are you doing?'

verses.kjv: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘This message is from the Sovereign LORD: It concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the people of Israel living there.’

verses.kjv: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
verses.decoded: Say, ‘I am a sign for you. Just as I have acted, so it will happen to them: they will be forced to leave and go into exile.’

verses.kjv: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.decoded: The prince among them will carry his belongings on his shoulder at dusk and leave. They will dig through the wall to escape, and he will cover his face so he cannot see the ground.

verses.kjv: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.decoded: I will trap him like a bird in a net; he will be caught and taken to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans. He will die there without ever seeing it.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.decoded: I will scatter everyone who tries to help him in all directions, and I will pursue them with the sword.

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.decoded: Then they will understand that I am the LORD when I scatter them among the nations and spread them across the lands.

verses.kjv: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: But I will spare a small number of them from the sword, famine, and disease so that they can tell the nations where they are taken about all the terrible things they did; and they will understand that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.decoded: Son of man, eat your food with fear and drink your water with anxiety and caution;

verses.kjv: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of the land, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the people of Jerusalem and Israel: They will eat their food with anxiety and drink their water in fear because the land will become empty and ruined due to the violence of its inhabitants.’

verses.kjv: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: The inhabited cities will be destroyed, and the land will become desolate; then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.decoded: Son of man, what is this saying among the people of Israel: ‘The time is long, and every prophecy fails’?

verses.kjv: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will put an end to this saying, and it will no longer be used in Israel. Tell them, “The time is near, and every prophecy will be fulfilled.”’

verses.kjv: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: There will be no more false visions or flattering lies in Israel.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD. When I speak, my words will happen without delay. In your lifetime, rebellious people, I will speak and make it happen, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.decoded: Again the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
verses.decoded: Son of man, the people of Israel say, ‘The visions he sees are for a long time from now, and his prophecies are about distant future events.’

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: So tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; what I have spoken will happen, declares the Sovereign LORD.’

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.decoded: Son of man, speak against the prophets of Israel who speak from their own imagination. Tell those who claim to speak for the LORD but do so from their own ideas, 'Listen to the word of the LORD!'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own thoughts and have seen nothing!

verses.kjv: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.decoded: Israel, your prophets are like foxes roaming the wilderness.

verses.kjv: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
verses.decoded: You have not repaired the broken places or built a protective wall for Israel to stand firm during the LORD’s day of judgment.
