verses.kjv: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.decoded: They have had worthless visions and told lies, claiming 'The LORD says,' even though the LORD did not send them. They gave others false hope that their words were true.

verses.kjv: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.decoded: Have you not seen false visions and spoken lies, saying 'The LORD says,' when I have not spoken at all?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have spoken nonsense and seen lies, I am against you.

verses.kjv: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: My power will come down on the prophets who see false visions and tell lies. They will not be part of my people, their names won’t be recorded in Israel’s records, and they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
verses.decoded: Because they have misled my people by saying 'Peace' when there is no peace. One builds a wall, but others cover it with weak, unprepared mortar.

verses.kjv: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.decoded: Tell those who cover the wall with weak mortar that it will collapse. Heavy rains, hailstones, and strong winds will destroy it.

verses.kjv: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.decoded: When the wall falls, won’t people ask you, 'Where is the mortar you used to cover it?'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
verses.decoded: So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will tear down the wall with a fierce wind in my anger. Heavy rains and hailstones will destroy it completely.

verses.kjv: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will break down the wall you covered with weak mortar and bring it to the ground, exposing its foundation. It will collapse, and you will be destroyed in the ruins. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.decoded: This is how I will bring my anger on the wall and those who covered it with weak mortar. I will say to you, 'The wall is gone, and so are those who covered it.'

verses.kjv: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: These are the prophets of Israel who predict peace for Jerusalem, but there is actually no peace, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn against the women of your people who prophesy based on their own ideas; speak out against them.

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?
verses.decoded: Say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who make padded charms for every arm and wear headbands to trap souls! Are you trying to trap the souls of my people, and yet also save those who come to you alive?’

verses.kjv: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
verses.decoded: Will you dishonor me among my people just for a little barley and some bread, killing souls that shouldn’t die and keeping alive souls that should die, by lying to my people who listen to your lies?

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the Lord GOD says: I am against your padded charms that you use to trap souls and make them flee. I will snatch those souls from your grasp and set them free.

verses.kjv: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will also tear off your headbands and rescue my people from your control; they will no longer be trapped by you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
verses.decoded: Because you lied and made the hearts of the innocent sad—hearts I did not make sad—and you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil by falsely promising them life,

verses.kjv: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: So you will no longer see meaningless visions or hear false predictions, because I will rescue my people from your control, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.decoded: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.decoded: Son of man, these people have placed idols in their hearts and have made their sins a barrier before them. Should I even listen to them when they come to me?

verses.kjv: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.decoded: So tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Any Israelite who has idols in their heart and whose sins block their way, yet comes to a prophet for guidance, I the LORD will answer them according to how many idols they have.’

verses.kjv: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.decoded: I do this to confront Israel in their own hearts because they have all turned away from me by worshiping idols.

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.decoded: So tell the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Turn away from your idols and stop doing all these detestable things.’

verses.kjv: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
verses.decoded: Anyone from Israel or foreigners living among them who turns away from me, sets idols in their heart, and comes to a prophet to ask about me—I the LORD will personally answer them.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: But I will oppose that person, make them an example and a warning, and remove them from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.decoded: If a prophet is led astray and speaks falsely, it is because I the LORD have allowed it. I will punish that prophet and remove them from among my people Israel.

verses.kjv: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
verses.decoded: Both the prophet and the person who seeks guidance from the prophet will share the same punishment for their sin.

verses.kjv: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is so Israel will no longer stray from me or be defiled by their sins, but instead be my people and I will be their God, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.decoded: Son of man, when the land sins greatly against me, I will punish it by cutting off its food supply, causing famine, and destroying both people and animals.

verses.kjv: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were there, their righteousness would only save themselves, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
verses.decoded: If I send wild animals to ravage the land until it becomes deserted and no one can travel through because of the animals,

verses.kjv: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.decoded: Even if these three men were in the land, I swear by the Lord GOD, they will not save their sons or daughters; only they themselves will be saved, but the land will remain devastated.

verses.kjv: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.decoded: Or if I send a sword to attack that land, commanding it to pass through and destroy both people and animals:

verses.kjv: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.decoded: Even if these three men were there, I swear by the Lord GOD, they will not save their sons or daughters; only they themselves will be saved.

verses.kjv: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.decoded: Or if I send a deadly disease into that land and pour out my anger in bloodshed to destroy both people and animals:

verses.kjv: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.decoded: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were there, I swear by the Lord GOD, they would not save their sons or daughters; they would only save themselves because of their righteousness.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: How much worse will it be when I send my four severe punishments on Jerusalem—the sword, famine, wild animals, and disease—to destroy both people and animals?

verses.kjv: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.decoded: But look, a small group of people—both sons and daughters—will be spared. They will come out to you, and you will observe how they live and act. This will bring you comfort about the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem and everything I have done to it.

verses.kjv: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: They will comfort you when you see how they live and behave, and you will understand that I have acted justly in everything I have done, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.decoded: Son of man, what makes the vine tree different from any other tree or branch in the forest?

verses.kjv: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.decoded: Can its wood be used for anything useful? Would anyone use a piece of it to hang something on?

verses.kjv: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.decoded: Look, it is thrown into the fire to be burned up; the fire consumes both ends and the middle. Can it still be used for anything?

verses.kjv: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.decoded: Even when it was intact, it was useless; how much more useless is it now that it has been burned?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: So says the Sovereign LORD: Just as I gave the vine tree to the fire to be burned, I will give the people of Jerusalem to destruction.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
verses.decoded: I will oppose them; they will escape one disaster only to be consumed by another. Then you will know that I am the LORD when I oppose them.

verses.kjv: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will lay the land waste because they have sinned, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Once more, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.decoded: Son of man, make Jerusalem aware of her disgusting sins,

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.decoded: Say to Jerusalem, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You were born and raised in the land of Canaan; your ancestors were Amorites and Hittites.’

verses.kjv: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.decoded: When you were born, your navel wasn’t cut, you weren’t washed or salted, and you weren’t wrapped in cloth.

verses.kjv: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.decoded: No one cared for you or showed you kindness; you were thrown out into the open field to be despised on the day you were born.

verses.kjv: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
verses.decoded: But when I passed by and saw you covered in your own blood, I said to you while you were still bleeding, ‘Live!’ I said, ‘Live!’

verses.kjv: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
verses.decoded: I made you grow like a plant in the field; you became tall and beautiful. Your breasts developed, your hair grew long, and you were no longer naked.

verses.kjv: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
verses.decoded: When I saw you, it was the time of love. I covered your nakedness with my cloak, made a solemn promise to you, and entered into a covenant with you. You became mine.

verses.kjv: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.decoded: I washed you with water to cleanse you, removing all your blood, and I anointed you with oil.

verses.kjv: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.decoded: I dressed you in embroidered clothes, gave you shoes made of fine leather, wrapped you in fine linen, and covered you with silk.

verses.kjv: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.decoded: I adorned you with jewelry, put bracelets on your arms, and a necklace around your neck.

verses.kjv: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.decoded: I put a jewel on your forehead, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

verses.kjv: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.decoded: You were dressed in gold and silver, fine linen, silk, and embroidered clothes. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You became very beautiful and grew into a powerful kingdom.

verses.kjv: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Your fame spread among the nations because of your beauty, which was perfect because of the glory I gave you, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.decoded: But you trusted in your own beauty and became unfaithful. Because of your fame, you prostituted yourself and slept with anyone who passed by; they all became yours.

verses.kjv: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.decoded: You took your clothes and decorated your sacred places with many colors, and acted like a prostitute there. Such things will not happen again, nor will it be allowed.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.decoded: You took the beautiful jewelry made from my gold and silver that I gave you, and made idols shaped like men, and committed spiritual adultery with them.

verses.kjv: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.decoded: You took your embroidered clothes and covered the idols with them, and placed my oil and incense in front of them.

verses.kjv: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: The food I gave you—fine flour, oil, and honey—that I used to nourish you, you offered it to your idols as a pleasing smell. This is what the Lord GOD says.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.decoded: You even took your own children, whom you bore for me, and sacrificed them to your idols to be destroyed. Is this not a serious part of your unfaithfulness?

verses.kjv: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.decoded: You killed my children and caused them to be burned in fire for your idols?

verses.kjv: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.decoded: Despite all your disgusting acts and unfaithfulness, you have forgotten the days of your youth when you were helpless and stained with blood.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the LORD GOD;)
verses.decoded: After all your evil deeds, the Lord GOD says, 'Woe, woe to you!'

verses.kjv: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.decoded: You have built a prominent place for yourself and set up shrines in every street.

verses.kjv: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.decoded: You built your shrines at every crossroads, making your beauty disgusting by prostituting yourself to everyone who passed by, increasing your unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.decoded: You have been unfaithful with your neighbors, the Egyptians, who are large and strong, and have increased your unfaithfulness to anger me.

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I have reached out against you, reduced your food supply, and handed you over to your enemies—the Philistine cities—who are ashamed of your immoral behavior.

verses.kjv: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.decoded: You have also been unfaithful with the Assyrians because you were never satisfied; you prostituted yourself to them but still were not content.

verses.kjv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.decoded: You have increased your unfaithfulness from the land of Canaan all the way to Chaldea, yet you were still not satisfied.

verses.kjv: How weak is thine heart, saith the LORD GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.decoded: How weak and foolish is your heart, says the Lord GOD, since you do all these things like a proud and unfaithful woman.

verses.kjv: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.decoded: You have built your important places at every main road and set up your altars in every street, but you have not acted like a prostitute by refusing payment.

verses.kjv: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.decoded: But you are like an unfaithful wife who takes other men instead of her husband!

verses.kjv: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.decoded: Other prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers and bribe them to come to you for your unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.decoded: You are different from other women in your unfaithfulness because no one pursues you to be unfaithful with you; instead, you pay them, but no one pays you. That’s why you are different.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.decoded: Therefore, prostitute, listen to what the LORD says:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have revealed your shame by your unfaithfulness with your lovers and with all the idols you detest, even sacrificing your children to them,

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.decoded: I will bring together all your lovers, those you enjoyed and those you hated; I will surround you with them and expose your shame so they will see everything.

verses.kjv: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.decoded: I will judge you as women who commit adultery and murder are judged; I will bring upon you punishment fueled by anger and jealousy.

verses.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.decoded: I will hand you over to them, and they will tear down your important places and altars; they will strip off your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and exposed.

verses.kjv: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.decoded: They will gather a crowd against you, stone you, and kill you with swords.

verses.kjv: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.decoded: They will burn your houses and carry out judgment in front of many women. I will stop you from being unfaithful, and you will no longer receive payment for it.

verses.kjv: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.decoded: Then I will calm my anger toward you, my jealousy will leave, and I will be silent and no longer angry.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.decoded: Because you have forgotten your early days and have angered me with all your actions, I will repay you for what you have done, declares the Sovereign LORD. You will not commit this wickedness again, which is worse than all your other sins.

verses.kjv: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.decoded: Everyone who uses proverbs will say this about you: 'Like mother, like daughter.'

verses.kjv: Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.decoded: You are the daughter of a mother who hated her husband and children, and you are like your sisters who also hated their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father was an Amorite.

verses.kjv: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.decoded: Your older sister is Samaria, along with her daughters who live to your left; and your younger sister, who lives to your right, is Sodom and her daughters.

verses.kjv: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.decoded: Although you did not follow their ways or commit their detestable acts, you acted even more corruptly than they did in every way, as if their sins were insignificant.

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, neither Sodom nor her daughters have done what you and your daughters have done.

verses.kjv: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.decoded: Look, this was the sin of your sister Sodom: she and her daughters were proud, well-fed, and careless, and they did not help the poor and needy.

verses.kjv: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.decoded: They were arrogant and committed detestable sins before me, so I removed them as I saw fit.

verses.kjv: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.decoded: Samaria has not committed even half of your sins, but you have multiplied your detestable acts more than they did, and you have even excused your sisters for all the wrongs you have done.

verses.kjv: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.decoded: You, who have judged your sisters, must also bear your own shame because you have committed sins more detestable than theirs. They are more righteous than you. Be ashamed and bear your disgrace for excusing your sisters.

verses.kjv: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.decoded: When I restore the captives of Sodom and her daughters, and the captives of Samaria and her daughters, then I will also restore your captives among them.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.decoded: So that you will bear your own shame and be embarrassed for all you have done, especially because you have been a comfort to them.

verses.kjv: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.decoded: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, and Samaria and her daughters, return to their former condition, then you and your daughters will also return to your former state.

verses.kjv: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.decoded: You did not mention your sister Sodom when you were proud and boastful.

verses.kjv: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.decoded: Before your wickedness was exposed, when you were insulted by the daughters of Aram and all around her, including the daughters of the Philistines who despise you.

verses.kjv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: You have carried your immoral acts and detestable sins, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will treat you as you have treated others, because you have despised the oath and broken the covenant.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.decoded: But I will remember my covenant with you from your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.decoded: Then you will remember how you behaved and feel ashamed when you accept your sisters—your older and younger sisters—and I will give them to you as daughters, but not as part of your original agreement.

verses.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
verses.decoded: I will make my covenant with you again, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: So that you will remember, feel ashamed, and never speak again because of your disgrace, when I forgive you for everything you have done, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.decoded: Son of man, tell the people of Israel a riddle and a parable;

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
verses.decoded: Say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: A powerful eagle with large wings, covered with many colorful feathers, came to Lebanon and took the top branch of the cedar tree.

verses.kjv: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.decoded: He cut off the top shoot of the cedar’s young twigs and took it to a trading land, placing it in a city of merchants.

verses.kjv: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
verses.decoded: He also took some seed from the land and planted it in a fertile field near abundant water, where he set it like a willow tree.

verses.kjv: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.decoded: It grew into a spreading, low vine whose branches reached toward him and roots were beneath him; it became a vine that produced branches and new shoots.

verses.kjv: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.decoded: There was another powerful eagle with large wings and many feathers; the vine bent its roots and branches toward this eagle so it could be watered by him.

verses.kjv: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.decoded: It was planted in good soil near abundant water to grow branches and bear fruit, becoming a beautiful vine.

verses.kjv: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.decoded: Say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will it succeed? Won’t its roots be pulled up and its fruit cut off so it withers? It will wither in its early growth, even without strong force or many people uprooting it.'

verses.kjv: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.decoded: Even though it was planted, will it thrive? No, it will completely wither when the east wind blows on it; it will dry up where it grew.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.decoded: Tell the rebellious people, 'Don’t you understand what this means? Look, the king of Babylon has come to Jerusalem, captured its king and officials, and taken them to Babylon.'

verses.kjv: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
verses.decoded: He took some of the king’s descendants, made a treaty with him, and secured an oath; he also took the powerful men of the land.

verses.kjv: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
verses.decoded: This was to humble the kingdom so it wouldn’t become proud, but by honoring the treaty it could survive.

verses.kjv: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.decoded: But the king rebelled by sending envoys to Egypt to get horses and soldiers. Will he succeed? Will he escape after doing this? Can he break the treaty and be saved?

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.decoded: I swear by my life, declares the Lord GOD, that he will die in Babylon, the very place where the king who appointed him reigns—because he disrespected that king’s oath and broke the agreement made with him.

verses.kjv: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.decoded: Pharaoh, despite his large army and many soldiers, will not be able to help him in battle by building fortifications or cutting off enemies.

verses.kjv: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.decoded: Because he disrespected the oath and broke the agreement he had firmly committed to, he will not get away with it.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.decoded: So says the Lord GOD: I swear by my life that I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant—he will face the consequences himself.

verses.kjv: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.decoded: I will trap him like a bird in a net; he will be caught and brought to Babylon, where I will confront him for the wrongs he has committed against me.

verses.kjv: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: All his escaped soldiers and followers will be killed by the sword, and those left will be scattered everywhere. Then you will understand that I, the LORD, have declared this.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will take the best branch from the tallest cedar tree, cut off a young, tender shoot from its top, and plant it on a high and prominent mountain.

verses.kjv: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.decoded: I will plant it on the mountain of Israel’s highest place, where it will grow branches and bear fruit, becoming a majestic cedar tree. Birds of every kind will live in its shade and shelter beneath its branches.

verses.kjv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it.
verses.decoded: All the trees in the field will recognize that I, the LORD, have brought down the tall tree, lifted up the low tree, dried up the green tree, and made the dry tree flourish. I, the LORD, have declared it and done it.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?
verses.decoded: Why do you use this saying about Israel: 'The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, you will no longer use this proverb in Israel.

verses.kjv: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.decoded: All lives belong to me. The life of a father and the life of his son both belong to me. The person who sins will die for their own sin.

verses.kjv: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.decoded: But if a person is righteous and does what is just and right,

verses.kjv: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.decoded: does not worship on the mountains or look to the idols of Israel’s people, does not dishonor his neighbor’s wife or come near a woman during her menstrual impurity,

verses.kjv: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.decoded: does not oppress anyone, returns what he has taken as a pledge, does no wrong by violence, gives food to the hungry, and clothes the naked,

verses.kjv: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.decoded: does not lend money at interest or take a profit, keeps his hands from doing wrong, and judges fairly between people,

verses.kjv: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: follows my laws and obeys my rules, acting honestly—he is righteous and will surely live, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
verses.decoded: But if he has a son who is a thief, a murderer, or who does any of these wrong things,

verses.kjv: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.decoded: who does not do what is right, but worships on the mountains and dishonors his neighbor’s wife,

verses.kjv: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.decoded: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not return what he has pledged, looks to idols, and commits detestable sins,

verses.kjv: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.decoded: lends money at interest and takes a profit—will he live? No! Because he has done all these detestable things, he must die. His punishment is on him.

verses.kjv: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
verses.decoded: But suppose he has a son who sees all the sins his father committed and refuses to do the same,

verses.kjv: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.decoded: who does not worship on the mountains or look to the idols of Israel’s people, and does not dishonor his neighbor’s wife,

verses.kjv: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
verses.decoded: He has not oppressed anyone, has not kept a pledged item from its owner, has not robbed by violence, but has given food to the hungry and clothed the naked.

verses.kjv: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.decoded: He has stopped exploiting the poor, has not charged interest or taken more than he should, has followed my laws and judgments; he will not die for his father's sins but will surely live.

verses.kjv: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.decoded: But his father, who cruelly oppressed others, violently robbed his brother, and did evil among his people, will die because of his own sins.

verses.kjv: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.decoded: You ask, 'Why? Doesn't the son suffer for the father's sins?' If the son does what is right and obeys all my laws, he will surely live.

verses.kjv: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.decoded: Each person is responsible for their own sin and will die for it. Children will not suffer for their parents' sins, nor parents for their children's. The righteous will be rewarded, and the wicked punished.

verses.kjv: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.decoded: But if a wicked person turns away from all their sins, obeys my laws, and does what is right, they will live and not die.

verses.kjv: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.decoded: All the sins they committed will be forgotten, and they will live because of the good they have done.

verses.kjv: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.decoded: Do I take pleasure in the death of the wicked? says the Lord GOD. Isn't it better that they turn from their evil ways and live?

verses.kjv: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.decoded: But if a righteous person turns away from doing right and commits the same sins as the wicked, will they live? No. Their past good deeds will not be remembered; they will die because of their sins.

verses.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the LORD is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.decoded: You say, 'God's way is unfair.' Listen, house of Israel: Isn't my way fair? Your ways are the ones that are unfair.

verses.kjv: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.decoded: If a righteous person turns away from doing right, commits sin, and dies in that state, they will die because of their own sins.

verses.kjv: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.decoded: But if a wicked person turns away from their sins and does what is right and lawful, they will save their life.

verses.kjv: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.decoded: Because they think about their actions and turn away from all their sins, they will surely live and not die.

verses.kjv: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the LORD is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.decoded: But the house of Israel says, 'God's way is unfair.' O Israel, isn't my way fair? Your ways are unfair.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will judge each of you, Israel, according to your own actions, says the Lord GOD. Repent and turn away from all your sins so that they will not destroy you.

verses.kjv: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.decoded: Get rid of all your sins that you have committed, and create in yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, people of Israel?

verses.kjv: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
verses.decoded: I do not want anyone to die, says the Lord GOD. So turn away from your sins and live.

verses.kjv: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.decoded: Also, raise a mournful song for the leaders of Israel,

verses.kjv: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.decoded: Say, 'Who is your mother? She is like a lioness who rested among lions and raised her cubs among young lions.'

verses.kjv: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.decoded: She raised one of her cubs, who grew into a young lion, learned to hunt, and became a fierce predator of people.

verses.kjv: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: Other nations heard about him; he was trapped and captured, then taken in chains to Egypt.

verses.kjv: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.decoded: When she realized her hope was gone, she raised another cub and made him a young lion.

verses.kjv: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.decoded: This new lion roamed among the lions, grew strong, learned to hunt, and devoured people.

verses.kjv: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.decoded: He was familiar with ruined palaces and destroyed cities; his roaring caused the land and everything in it to become desolate.

verses.kjv: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.decoded: Nations from all around surrounded him and trapped him in a net; he was caught in their trap.

verses.kjv: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.decoded: They imprisoned him in chains and took him to the king of Babylon, locking him away so he could no longer be heard in Israel’s hills.

verses.kjv: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.decoded: Your mother is like a vine planted near water, full of life and branches because of the abundant water.

verses.kjv: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.decoded: She had strong branches that served as rulers’ scepters; she stood tall among many branches, showing her greatness.

verses.kjv: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.decoded: But she was violently uprooted, thrown to the ground; the east wind dried her fruit, her strong branches broke and withered, and fire destroyed them.

verses.kjv: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.decoded: Now she is planted in a barren wilderness, a dry and thirsty land.

verses.kjv: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.decoded: A fire has burned one of her branches, destroying her fruit, leaving her with no strong branch to rule as a scepter. This is a lament, a song of mourning.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
verses.decoded: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to ask the LORD for guidance and sat down in front of me.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.decoded: Son of man, tell the elders of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Have you really come to ask me for guidance? As surely as I live, I will not listen to you.'

verses.kjv: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.decoded: Son of man, will you judge them? Will you judge them and make them aware of the terrible sins their ancestors committed?

verses.kjv: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
verses.decoded: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I chose Israel and promised the descendants of Jacob that I was the LORD their God, and made myself known to them while they were in Egypt,'

verses.kjv: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.decoded: On the day I promised to bring them out of Egypt into a land I had chosen for them, a land flowing with milk and honey—the most glorious land of all,

verses.kjv: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: I told them, 'Each of you must get rid of the disgusting things you desire and stop worshiping the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.'

verses.kjv: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: But they rebelled against me and refused to listen. They did not get rid of their disgusting desires or stop worshiping the idols of Egypt. So I said, 'I will unleash my anger on them and punish them right there in Egypt.'

verses.kjv: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: But I acted to protect my reputation so that it would not be dishonored among the nations where they lived. I made myself known to them by bringing them out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.decoded: So I brought them out of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.decoded: I gave them my laws and made my rules known to them. If anyone obeys them, they will live by them.

verses.kjv: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
verses.decoded: I also gave them the Sabbath as a sign between me and them, so they would know that I am the LORD who makes them holy.

verses.kjv: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.decoded: But Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not obey my laws or respect my rules, which if followed would bring life. They also greatly defiled my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my anger on them in the wilderness and destroy them.

verses.kjv: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.decoded: But I acted to protect my name so it would not be dishonored among the nations where I had brought them out.

verses.kjv: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.decoded: Still, I promised them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey—the most glorious land of all,

verses.kjv: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.decoded: Because they rejected my laws, did not follow my rules, and defiled my holy days, their hearts were devoted to their idols.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Yet I chose not to destroy them completely or wipe them out while they were in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.decoded: But I told their children in the wilderness, 'Do not follow the laws your parents broke, do not obey their rules, and do not pollute yourselves with their idols.'

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.decoded: I am the LORD your God; follow my laws, obey my rules, and live by them.

verses.kjv: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Keep my Sabbaths holy; they will be a sign between me and you so you will know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: But the children still rebelled against me; they did not follow my laws or obey my rules, which if followed, would bring life. They defiled my Sabbaths. So I said I would unleash my anger on them in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.decoded: But I held back my hand and acted for the sake of my reputation, so that my name would not be dishonored among the nations where I had brought them out.

verses.kjv: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.decoded: I promised them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and spread them across the countries.

verses.kjv: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
verses.decoded: Because they did not follow my laws, rejected my rules, defiled my Sabbaths, and their eyes chased after their ancestors' idols.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.decoded: So I gave them laws that were not good and rules that would not bring life;

verses.kjv: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I defiled them by their own offerings, causing them to sacrifice all their firstborn by fire, making them desolate so they would know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, tell the people of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Your ancestors have insulted me by breaking my covenant and sinning against me.'

verses.kjv: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.decoded: When I brought them into the land I promised them, they saw every high hill and thick forest and offered sacrifices there. They made offerings that provoked me, including pleasing smells and poured-out drinks.

verses.kjv: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.decoded: I asked them, 'What is this high place you are going to?' It is still called Bamah today.

verses.kjv: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Are you defiled like your ancestors? Do you commit sexual immorality following their disgusting practices?'

verses.kjv: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.decoded: When you offer your gifts and make your sons pass through fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols even now. Will you ask me for guidance, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not listen to you.

verses.kjv: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.decoded: You will never succeed in saying, 'We will be like the nations and serve wood and stone idols.'

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will rule over you with great power, outstretched arm, and fierce anger.

verses.kjv: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.decoded: I will bring you out from among the nations and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered, using great power, an outstretched arm, and fierce anger.

verses.kjv: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.decoded: I will bring you into the wilderness among the nations and there I will confront you personally.

verses.kjv: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Just as I confronted your ancestors in the wilderness near Egypt, I will confront you, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.decoded: I will make you submit to discipline and bring you into a renewed covenant relationship.

verses.kjv: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will remove from among you the rebels and those who sin against me. I will take them out of the land where they live, and they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.decoded: As for you, O house of Israel, says the Lord GOD: go ahead and serve your idols if you refuse to listen to me, but do not defile my holy name anymore with your offerings and idols.

verses.kjv: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.decoded: On my holy mountain, the highest mountain in Israel, says the Lord GOD, all the people of Israel living in the land will serve me. I will accept them and require your offerings, your firstfruits, and all your holy gifts.

verses.kjv: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.decoded: I will accept you with pleasing aroma when I bring you out from among the nations and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered. I will be honored through you before the nations.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.decoded: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you back to the land of Israel, the land I promised to give to your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.decoded: There you will remember your actions and all the ways you defiled yourselves, and you will feel disgusted with yourselves for all the evil you have done.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will know that I am the LORD when I act on your behalf for my own name’s sake, not because of your evil ways or corrupt deeds, O house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to the south and send your message there; prophesy against the forest in the southern region.

verses.kjv: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.decoded: Tell the southern forest to listen to the LORD’s message: I will start a fire in you that will consume every green and dry tree. The fire will burn fiercely and cannot be put out, and everyone from south to north will be affected by it.

verses.kjv: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.decoded: Everyone will see that I, the LORD, started this fire; it will never be extinguished.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.decoded: Then I said, ‘Oh Lord GOD, people say about me, “Doesn’t he speak in riddles?”’

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to Jerusalem and deliver my message to its sacred places. Proclaim judgment against the land of Israel.

verses.kjv: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.decoded: Tell the land of Israel, ‘This is what the LORD says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and will destroy both the righteous and the wicked among you.’

verses.kjv: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.decoded: Since I will destroy both the righteous and the wicked, my sword will come out of its sheath to strike everyone—from the south to the north.

verses.kjv: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.decoded: So that everyone will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword and it will not be sheathed again.

verses.kjv: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, groan deeply and painfully, showing your grief openly before them.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: When they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ say, ‘Because the news is coming.’ Everyone’s heart will melt, their hands will become weak, their spirit will faint, and their knees will be as weak as water. Look, it is coming and will happen, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.decoded: Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the LORD says: A sword, a sword has been sharpened and polished.’

verses.kjv: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
verses.decoded: It has been sharpened to bring severe slaughter and polished to shine brightly. Should we celebrate? It despises the authority of my son, like every tree does.

verses.kjv: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.decoded: It has been polished so it can be wielded. This sword is sharpened and polished to be placed in the hand of the one who kills.

verses.kjv: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
verses.decoded: Cry out and wail, son of man, because this will come upon my people, including all the leaders of Israel. Terror caused by the sword will fall on my people. So strike your thigh in grief.

verses.kjv: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is a test. What if the sword rejects even the rod? It will no longer exist, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
verses.decoded: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands. Let the sword strike a third time—the sword that kills the great men, entering even their private rooms.

verses.kjv: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.decoded: I have aimed the sword’s tip at all their gates to make their hearts weak and increase their destruction. It is polished and ready for slaughter.

verses.kjv: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
verses.decoded: Go either to the right or to the left, wherever you decide to go.
