verses.kjv: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said it.
verses.decoded: I will strike my hands together and then calm my anger; I, the LORD, have spoken.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.decoded: Son of man, mark out two roads where the king of Babylon’s sword will come; both will come from the same land. Pick a spot at the start of the road leading to the city.

verses.kjv: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.decoded: Mark a road for the sword to reach Rabbah, the city of the Ammonites, and also to Judah in fortified Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon stood at the crossroads, ready to decide which way to go. He used divination—he polished his arrows, consulted idols, and examined the liver of a sacrificed animal.

verses.kjv: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
verses.decoded: On his right was the sign for attacking Jerusalem: to assign commanders, begin the slaughter, shout battle cries, set up battering rams against the gates, build siege ramps, and construct a fort.

verses.kjv: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.decoded: To those who swore oaths, this will seem like false prophecy, but God will remember their sins so they will be captured.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.decoded: The Sovereign LORD says: Because your sins are well known and your wrongdoing is clear in everything you do, you will be caught and held accountable.

verses.kjv: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
verses.decoded: And you, defiled and wicked prince of Israel, your time has come—the time when sin will be ended.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Take off the royal crown and diadem; it will no longer be the same. Lift up the lowly and bring down the exalted.

verses.kjv: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
verses.decoded: I will overturn it completely, and it will not exist anymore until the one who has the rightful claim comes; then I will give it to him.

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
verses.decoded: Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Sovereign LORD says about the Ammonites and their insults—The sword is drawn and polished, ready for slaughter because of their pride.

verses.kjv: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
verses.decoded: While they see worthless visions and tell lies to you, they bring you under the control of the slain—the wicked whose time has come to end their sin.

verses.kjv: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
verses.decoded: Should I put the sword back in its sheath? No, I will judge you in the place where you were born, in your own land.

verses.kjv: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
verses.decoded: I will unleash my anger against you; I will drive you with the fierce fire of my wrath and hand you over to cruel people who are experts in destruction.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: You will be like fuel for the fire; your blood will stain the land, and you will be completely forgotten. This is the declaration of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.decoded: Son of man, will you judge this city full of bloodshed? Yes, you must reveal to her all the terrible things she has done.

verses.kjv: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.decoded: Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The city sheds blood within itself, bringing on its own destruction, and makes idols that pollute it.’

verses.kjv: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.decoded: You are guilty because of the blood you have shed, and you have polluted yourself with the idols you made. Your time is almost up, your years have nearly come. That is why I have made you a disgrace among the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.

verses.kjv: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
verses.decoded: People nearby and far away will mock you because you are infamous and deeply troubled.

verses.kjv: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.decoded: Look, the leaders of Israel within you have all used their power to shed blood.

verses.kjv: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.decoded: In you, they disrespect their own parents; in your midst, they oppress foreigners; you mistreat orphans and widows.

verses.kjv: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.decoded: You have shown contempt for my sacred things and desecrated my Sabbaths.

verses.kjv: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
verses.decoded: There are people in you who spread lies to cause murder; they feast on the hills and commit sexual sins in your midst.

verses.kjv: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.decoded: In you, people have violated their own relatives; in you, they have defiled the woman dedicated to impurity.

verses.kjv: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.decoded: Someone has committed a terrible sin with a neighbor’s wife; another has sexually abused his daughter-in-law; and someone else has humiliated his sister, his father’s daughter.

verses.kjv: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: In you, people accept bribes to commit murder; you charge interest and make profits unfairly, greedily exploiting your neighbors—and you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I have taken action against your dishonest profits and the bloodshed in your midst.

verses.kjv: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.decoded: Will your heart be able to stand, or your hands be strong, on the day I punish you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
verses.decoded: I will scatter you among the nations and spread you across the countries, cleansing you of your filthiness.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: You will suffer disgrace among the nations, and then you will understand that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
verses.decoded: Son of man, Israel has become worthless to me—like scrap metal made of bronze, tin, iron, and lead mixed in the fire; they are like the impurities removed from silver.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have all become worthless, I will gather you together in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.decoded: Just as metals like silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin are gathered into a furnace and heated until they melt, I will gather you in my anger and fury and leave you there to be melted.

verses.kjv: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: Yes, I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my anger, and you will be melted right in the middle of it.

verses.kjv: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.decoded: Just as silver melts in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted there, and you will realize that I, the LORD, have poured out my anger on you.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.decoded: Son of man, tell Jerusalem, 'You are a land that has not been purified or refreshed by rain on the day of punishment.'

verses.kjv: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: Her prophets conspire like roaring lions tearing their prey; they have destroyed lives, stolen valuable things, and caused many widows in the city.

verses.kjv: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.decoded: Her priests have broken my laws and desecrated my sacred things; they do not distinguish between what is holy and what is common, or between clean and unclean. They ignore my Sabbaths, and as a result, I am dishonored among them.

verses.kjv: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.decoded: Her leaders are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood and destroying lives to gain wealth dishonestly.

verses.kjv: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verses.decoded: Her prophets deceive the people with false promises, seeing meaningless visions and telling lies, claiming, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says,' even though the LORD has not spoken.

verses.kjv: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.decoded: The people of the land have committed oppression and robbery; they have mistreated the poor and needy and have wrongfully oppressed foreigners.

verses.kjv: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.decoded: I looked for someone to stand in the gap and protect the land by interceding before me, so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one.

verses.kjv: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: That is why I have unleashed my anger against them; I have destroyed them with the fire of my wrath. I have repaid them according to their own actions, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.decoded: Son of man, there were two women who were sisters, daughters of the same mother:

verses.kjv: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.decoded: They were unfaithful in Egypt, acting promiscuously when they were young; it was there that their virginity was taken and harmed.

verses.kjv: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.decoded: Their names were Aholah, the older sister, and Aholibah, her sister. They belonged to me and had children. Aholah represents Samaria, and Aholibah represents Jerusalem. (Aholah means 'her tent' or 'tabernacle'; Aholibah means 'my tabernacle is in her.')

verses.kjv: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.decoded: Aholah was unfaithful to me while she belonged to me; she loved her neighbors, the Assyrians, as her lovers.

verses.kjv: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.decoded: These lovers were dressed in blue, commanders and leaders, all handsome young men riding horses.

verses.kjv: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.decoded: She was unfaithful with all the best men of Assyria and with everyone she loved; she also defiled herself by worshiping their idols.

verses.kjv: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.decoded: She did not abandon the unfaithfulness she had from Egypt; in her youth, she was with them, and they harmed her virginity and acted promiscuously with her.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.decoded: So I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians, whom she loved.

verses.kjv: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.decoded: They exposed her shame, captured her children, and killed her with the sword. She became well known among women because judgment was carried out against her.

verses.kjv: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.decoded: When her sister Aholibah saw this, she became even more unfaithful and lustful than her sister, committing more acts of unfaithfulness than she did.

verses.kjv: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.decoded: She loved her neighbors, the Assyrians, commanders and rulers dressed in fine clothes, horsemen riding horses, all handsome young men.

verses.kjv: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.decoded: I saw that she was unfaithful and that they led her astray in every way.

verses.kjv: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.decoded: She increased her unfaithfulness when she saw images of Chaldean men painted on the wall in bright red colors,

verses.kjv: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.decoded: Wearing belts around their waists and elaborate headgear, all of them noble-looking men, dressed like the Babylonians from Chaldea, their homeland.

verses.kjv: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.decoded: As soon as she saw them, she became infatuated with them and sent messengers to them in Babylonia.

verses.kjv: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.decoded: The Babylonians came to her as lovers and defiled her with their unfaithfulness; she became polluted by them, and her loyalty was broken.

verses.kjv: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.decoded: She exposed her unfaithfulness and shame; then I turned away from her, just as I had turned away from her sister.

verses.kjv: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: But she increased her unfaithfulness by remembering her youthful sins when she was unfaithful in Egypt.

verses.kjv: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.decoded: She was infatuated with her lovers, whose bodies were strong like donkeys and whose offspring were like horses.

verses.kjv: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.decoded: You remembered your youthful promiscuity, nursing from the Egyptians as a child would nurse from a mother’s breasts.

verses.kjv: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.decoded: Therefore, Aholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring your former lovers, those you turned away from, against you from every direction.

verses.kjv: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.decoded: The Babylonians, Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians—strong, handsome young men, commanders and leaders, famous nobles—all riding horses—will come against you.

verses.kjv: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.decoded: They will attack you with chariots, wagons, wheels, and large armies equipped with shields, helmets, and armor all around. I will place judgment before them, and they will judge you by their laws.

verses.kjv: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.decoded: I will bring my jealousy against you, and they will attack you fiercely. They will cut off your nose and ears; the survivors will die by the sword. They will capture your sons and daughters, and the rest will be burned.

verses.kjv: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.decoded: They will strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewelry.

verses.kjv: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.decoded: I will stop your unfaithfulness and the sins you brought from Egypt, so you will no longer look to or remember Egypt.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will hand you over to those you hate, to those you have rejected.

verses.kjv: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.decoded: They will treat you cruelly, steal all your wealth, and leave you exposed and ashamed, revealing all your unfaithfulness and sins.

verses.kjv: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.decoded: I will do these things to you because you have been unfaithful to me by following foreign nations and have been defiled by their idols.

verses.kjv: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.decoded: You have followed the same path as your sister, so I will make you drink the same punishment she faced.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.decoded: The Lord says you will drink deeply and fully from the same cup of judgment as your sister; you will be mocked and ridiculed because the punishment is severe.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.decoded: You will be overwhelmed with confusion and grief, drinking the cup of shock and destruction—the same cup your sister Samaria drank.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will drink it completely, even to the dregs, breaking the cup in your distress and causing yourself great pain, because the Lord has declared it.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.decoded: The Lord says: Because you have forgotten me and rejected me, you will suffer the consequences of your own immoral actions.

verses.kjv: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.decoded: The Lord said to me, 'Son of man, will you judge Aholah and Aholibah? Tell them about their disgusting sins.'

verses.kjv: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.decoded: They have been unfaithful and guilty of murder; they have worshiped idols and even sacrificed their own children by burning them.

verses.kjv: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.decoded: They have also desecrated my holy place and disrespected my sacred days.

verses.kjv: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.decoded: After sacrificing their children to idols, they would come into my temple on the same day and defile it; this is what they have done right in my presence.

verses.kjv: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.decoded: You sent for men from distant places, messengers were sent and they came; you prepared yourself by washing, applying makeup, and adorning yourself with jewelry to meet them.

verses.kjv: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.decoded: You sat on a fine bed with a table set before you, where you placed my incense and my oil.

verses.kjv: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.decoded: There was the sound of a relaxed crowd with her; common men brought Sabeans from the desert, who wore bracelets and beautiful crowns.

verses.kjv: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.decoded: I asked the woman experienced in adultery, 'Will these men now be unfaithful with her, and will she be unfaithful with them?'

verses.kjv: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.decoded: But they went to her just like men go to a prostitute; this is how they treated Aholah and Aholibah, the unfaithful women.

verses.kjv: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.decoded: The righteous will judge them like unfaithful women and murderers, because they have been unfaithful and guilty of bloodshed.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will send a group of people against them, and they will be taken away and plundered.

verses.kjv: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.decoded: The invading group will throw stones at them and kill them with swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses down.

verses.kjv: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.decoded: In this way, I will stop all immoral behavior in the land so that all women will learn not to follow your sinful ways.

verses.kjv: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: They will repay you for your immoral acts, and you will carry the consequences of your idolatry; then you will understand that I am the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.decoded: Son of man, write down this exact date—the very day the king of Babylon began his siege against Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.decoded: Tell the rebellious people this parable from the Sovereign LORD: Put a pot on the fire and pour water into it.

verses.kjv: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.decoded: Put all the best pieces into the pot—the thigh, the shoulder, and the choicest bones.

verses.kjv: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.decoded: Use the best parts of the flock for the fire beneath the pot; make it boil thoroughly so the bones inside cook well.

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the city full of bloodshed—the pot full of scum that hasn’t been cleaned! Remove the scum bit by bit; don’t let any part be spared.

verses.kjv: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.decoded: Her guilt is right in her heart; she piled up the blood on a rock and didn’t even cover it with dust.

verses.kjv: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.decoded: She did this to provoke anger and bring about punishment. I have exposed her guilt openly so it cannot be hidden.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the city full of bloodshed! I will build a huge fire to burn it up.

verses.kjv: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.decoded: Pile on the wood, light the fire, burn the flesh completely, season it well, and burn the bones too.

verses.kjv: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.decoded: Then place the empty pot on the hot coals so the metal heats up and melts away the impurities, burning off all the scum.

verses.kjv: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
verses.decoded: She has exhausted herself with lies, and her heavy scum has not been removed; it will be burned up in the fire.

verses.kjv: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
verses.decoded: Your filth is full of sin. I have tried to cleanse you, but you refused. Now you will not be cleansed until I have poured out my anger on you.

verses.kjv: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, have declared this, and it will happen. I will not change my mind or show mercy. You will be judged according to your own actions, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.decoded: Son of man, look, I am taking away the thing you love most with a single blow; yet you will not mourn or weep, and your tears will not flow.

verses.kjv: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.decoded: Stop crying and don’t mourn for the dead. Tie your headband on, put your shoes on, don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat food meant for mourners.

verses.kjv: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.decoded: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and that evening my wife died. The next morning I did exactly as I was told.

verses.kjv: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
verses.decoded: The people asked me, 'Won’t you explain what these actions mean for us?'

verses.kjv: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: I answered them, 'The LORD’s message came to me, saying,'

verses.kjv: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: I will desecrate my sanctuary—the pride of your strength, the thing you long for, and what your soul loves most. Your remaining sons and daughters will be killed by the sword.’

verses.kjv: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.decoded: You will do as I have done: you will not cover your lips or eat the food given to mourners.

verses.kjv: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.decoded: You will keep your headbands on and your shoes on your feet. You will not mourn or weep openly, but you will waste away because of your sins and grieve quietly with each other.

verses.kjv: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Ezekiel is a sign for you. You will do exactly as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.decoded: Son of man, won’t the day come when I take away their strength, their pride, the thing they long for, and what they treasure most—their sons and daughters?

verses.kjv: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
verses.decoded: On that day, someone who survives will come to you and tell you about it so you can hear it with your own ears.

verses.kjv: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: On that day your mouth will be opened to the survivor; you will speak and no longer be silent. You will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention toward the Ammonites and deliver a prophecy against them;

verses.kjv: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.decoded: Tell the Ammonites: Listen to the message from the Sovereign LORD. This is what the LORD says: Because you said, 'Good! The LORD’s sanctuary is defiled, the land of Israel is ruined, and Judah’s people are taken into exile,'

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.decoded: I will hand you over to the people from the east as their property. They will build their palaces and live in you. They will eat your crops and drink your milk.

verses.kjv: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will turn Rabbah into a place where camels rest and the Ammonites into a pasture for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you clapped your hands, stamped your feet, and rejoiced with all your hatred against the land of Israel,

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will reach out against you and hand you over to foreign nations to be plundered. I will wipe you out from among the people and cause you to disappear from the land. I will destroy you, and then you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because Moab and Seir say, 'Look, Judah is just like all the other nations,'

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.decoded: I will attack Moab’s border cities—the pride of the land—Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim.

verses.kjv: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.decoded: I will hand them over to the people from the east along with the Ammonites, so that the Ammonites will be forgotten among the nations.

verses.kjv: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will punish Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because Edom has taken revenge against Judah, acting with great hostility and retaliation,

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will reach out against Edom and destroy both people and animals. I will make Teman a wasteland, and those from Dedan will be killed by the sword.

verses.kjv: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will take revenge on Edom through my people Israel. They will carry out my anger and fury against Edom, and Edom will know that I am taking vengeance, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because the Philistines have acted out of revenge and hatred, trying to destroy for their longstanding grudge,

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will reach out my hand against the Philistines, destroy the Cherethites, and wipe out what is left along the coastline.

verses.kjv: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.decoded: I will bring severe punishment on them with fierce anger, and they will recognize that I am the LORD when I carry out my judgment against them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the Lord spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
verses.decoded: Son of man, because Tyre has said about Jerusalem, 'Aha! The city gates are broken, and now she has turned to me. I will be filled with her wealth since she is destroyed,'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, just as the sea causes its waves to rise.

verses.kjv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.decoded: They will destroy Tyre’s walls and break down her towers. I will scrape away her dust and make her like the bare top of a rock.

verses.kjv: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.decoded: It will become a place for spreading fishing nets in the middle of the sea. I have declared it, says the Sovereign Lord, and it will be plundered by the nations.

verses.kjv: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Her settlements on the mainland will be killed by the sword, and they will know that I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.decoded: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, a mighty king from the north, with horses, chariots, cavalry, and a vast army.

verses.kjv: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.decoded: He will kill your settlements on the mainland with the sword. He will build a siege ramp against you, set up siege engines, and raise his shield against you.

verses.kjv: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.decoded: He will position siege weapons against your walls and use axes to break down your towers.

verses.kjv: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.decoded: Because of the many horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will tremble at the noise of horsemen, wheels, and chariots as he enters your gates like men entering a city with a broken wall.

verses.kjv: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.decoded: His horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong defenses will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.decoded: They will loot your wealth and seize your goods. They will tear down your walls and destroy your beautiful homes. They will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.

verses.kjv: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.decoded: I will silence your songs, and the sound of your harps will never be heard again.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will make you like the bare top of a rock; you will be a place for spreading fishing nets and will never be rebuilt. I, the Lord, have spoken this, declares the Sovereign Lord.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Tyre: Won’t the islands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded cry out and the slaughter happens in your midst?

verses.kjv: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.decoded: All the rulers of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove their royal robes and fine clothes. They will dress themselves in fear and sit on the ground, trembling constantly and amazed at you.

verses.kjv: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
verses.decoded: They will mourn for you and say, 'How have you been destroyed, you city full of sailors, famous and powerful on the sea, whose people caused fear to all who lived nearby!'

verses.kjv: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.decoded: The islands will shake and be disturbed on the day you fall; even the islands in the sea will be upset by your destruction.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will make you a deserted city, like places no one lives in. I will cause the deep waters to rise over you and cover you completely.

verses.kjv: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.decoded: I will bring you down to join those who go to the grave, the ancient dead, and place you in the lowest parts of the earth, in deserted places long abandoned, so no one will live there anymore. Meanwhile, I will honor the land of the living.

verses.kjv: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will make you a frightening example, and you will cease to exist. Even if people search for you, they will never find you again, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.decoded: Son of man, sing a funeral song for Tyre;

verses.kjv: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.decoded: Say to Tyre, 'You who sit at the entrance to the sea and trade with many islands, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Tyre, you claimed, "I am perfectly beautiful."'

verses.kjv: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.decoded: Your territory is in the heart of the seas, and your builders have made you perfectly beautiful.

verses.kjv: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.decoded: Your ship’s planks were made from fir trees of Senir; your masts were made from Lebanon’s cedars.

verses.kjv: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.decoded: Your oars were made from Bashan’s oaks; your benches were made of ivory brought by the Assyrians from the islands of Chittim.

verses.kjv: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.decoded: Your sails were fine embroidered linen from Egypt; blue and purple cloth from the islands of Elishah covered you.

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.decoded: The people of Sidon and Arvad manned your ships; your skilled leaders were your pilots.

verses.kjv: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.decoded: The elders and experts from Gebal sealed your ships; many ships and sailors were part of your trade business.

verses.kjv: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.decoded: Soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Put were in your army; they hung their shields and helmets on your walls, showing your strength.

verses.kjv: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.decoded: Men from Arvad guarded your walls, and the Gammadims were in your towers; they hung their shields on your walls, completing your beauty.

verses.kjv: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.decoded: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth; they traded silver, iron, tin, and lead at your markets.

verses.kjv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.decoded: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants; they traded slaves and bronze goods in your market.

verses.kjv: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.decoded: The people of Togarmah traded horses, riders, and mules at your markets.

verses.kjv: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.decoded: The men of Dedan were your merchants; many islands supplied your goods, including gifts of ivory horns and ebony.

verses.kjv: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.decoded: Syria was your trading partner because of the many goods you produced; they took part in your markets with emeralds, purple cloth, embroidered fabrics, fine linen, coral, and agate.

verses.kjv: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.decoded: Judah and Israel were your traders; they sold wheat from Minnith and Pannag, along with honey, oil, and balm in your market.

verses.kjv: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.decoded: Damascus was your trading partner because of the many valuable goods you made, including the wine of Helbon and white wool.

verses.kjv: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.decoded: Dan and Javan traveled back and forth and took part in your markets; your market had bright iron, cassia, and calamus.

verses.kjv: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.decoded: Dedan was your trader in fine garments used for decorating chariots.

verses.kjv: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
verses.decoded: Arabia and all the leaders of Kedar traded with you in lambs, rams, and goats; they were your merchants in these goods.

verses.kjv: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.decoded: The traders from Sheba and Raamah were your merchants; they participated in your markets with the finest spices, precious stones, and gold.

verses.kjv: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
verses.decoded: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad were your trading partners.

verses.kjv: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.decoded: These merchants dealt in all kinds of goods, including blue cloth, embroidered fabrics, and chests filled with fine clothing, tied with cords and made of cedar wood.

verses.kjv: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.decoded: The ships from Tarshish praised you in your market; you were filled with goods and became very famous across the seas.

verses.kjv: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.decoded: Your sailors took you into deep waters, but the east wind has shattered you in the middle of the sea.

verses.kjv: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.decoded: Your wealth, markets, goods, sailors, pilots, shipbuilders, merchants, and all your warriors and people in your city will fall into the sea on the day you are destroyed.

verses.kjv: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.decoded: The surrounding areas will tremble when your sailors cry out in distress.

verses.kjv: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.decoded: All the rowers, sailors, and sea pilots will leave their ships and stand on the shore;

verses.kjv: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.decoded: They will shout against you in sorrow, cry bitterly, throw dust on their heads, and roll in ashes in grief.

verses.kjv: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.decoded: They will shave their heads completely for you, put on sackcloth, and mourn for you with deep sorrow and loud crying.

verses.kjv: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.decoded: As they mourn, they will sing a funeral song for you, saying, 'What city is like Tyre, destroyed in the middle of the sea?'

verses.kjv: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.decoded: When your goods were shipped across the seas, you supplied many people and made the kings of the earth rich with your vast wealth and trade.

verses.kjv: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.decoded: But when the seas break you apart in the depths of the waters, your goods and all your crew will be lost within you.

verses.kjv: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.decoded: All the island peoples will be shocked by you, and their kings will be terrified and visibly disturbed.

verses.kjv: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
verses.decoded: The merchants of the nations will mock you; you will become a horror and will never exist again.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.decoded: Human one, tell the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you are proud and say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne like a god in the middle of the seas," but you are only a man, not a god, even though you think like a god,'

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.decoded: You claim to be wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you.

verses.kjv: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.decoded: With your wisdom and understanding, you have gained wealth and stored up gold and silver in your treasuries.

verses.kjv: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.decoded: Because of your great wisdom and your trading, you have grown rich, and your heart has become proud because of your wealth.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.decoded: So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you think you are like God,

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.decoded: I will bring foreigners against you—terrible warriors from other nations. They will attack your great wisdom and dishonor your glory.

verses.kjv: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.decoded: They will drag you down to the grave, and you will die like those killed in the seas.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.decoded: Will you still claim before the one who kills you, "I am a god"? But you will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of the one who kills you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will die like the uncircumcised—at the hands of foreigners. I have declared it, says the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.decoded: Human one, mourn for the king of Tyre and say to him, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You are the model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.'

verses.kjv: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.decoded: You were in Eden, the garden of God; you were covered with every precious stone—ruby, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, emerald, carbuncle, and gold. The music of your tambourines and pipes was prepared for you on the day you were created.

verses.kjv: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.decoded: You were the anointed guardian cherub, and I placed you there. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among fiery stones.

verses.kjv: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.decoded: You were flawless in your ways from the day you were created until wickedness was found in you.

verses.kjv: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.decoded: Because of your many trades, violence has filled your heart, and you have sinned. So I will treat you as unholy and remove you from God's holy mountain. I will destroy you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

verses.kjv: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.decoded: Your heart became proud because of your beauty, and your wisdom was corrupted because of your splendor. I will bring you down to the ground and expose you before kings so they can see you.

verses.kjv: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.decoded: You have polluted your sacred places with many sins, especially through your dishonest trading. Therefore, I will cause a fire to come from within you that will consume you, turning you to ashes in front of all who see.

verses.kjv: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
verses.decoded: Everyone who knows you among the nations will be shocked at your downfall; you will become a frightening example and will never exist again.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Once more, the Lord spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to Sidon and deliver a prophecy against it.

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.decoded: Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Sidon, and I will bring glory to myself through you. People will know that I am the Lord when I carry out my judgments against you and make myself holy through you.’

verses.kjv: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will send disease and bloodshed into her streets. The wounded will be judged by the sword all around her, and people will know that I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: No longer will Israel be troubled or hurt by those around them who despise them. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord God says: When I bring the people of Israel back from the nations where they have been scattered, and when I make myself holy among them in the sight of the nations, they will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.

verses.kjv: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
verses.decoded: They will live there in safety, build homes, and plant vineyards. They will live confidently because I will punish all who despise them around them. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.

verses.kjv: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and deliver a prophecy against him and all of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.decoded: Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon lying among your rivers, who claims, “The river belongs to me; I made it for myself.”’

verses.kjv: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
verses.decoded: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your rivers cling to your scales. I will pull you out of your rivers, and all the fish will cling to your scales.

verses.kjv: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.decoded: I will leave you and all the fish of your rivers stranded in the wilderness. You will fall on open ground and will not be gathered or collected. I have given you as food to the wild animals and birds of the air.

verses.kjv: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: All the people of Egypt will know that I am the LORD because they have been a weak support to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.decoded: When Israel relied on you for help, you broke their arms and shoulders. When they leaned on you, you caused them to stumble and fail.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring a sword against you and kill both people and animals.

verses.kjv: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
verses.decoded: The land of Egypt will become desolate and ruined, and they will know that I am the LORD, because they said, ‘The river belongs to me; I made it.’

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I am against you and your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt completely desolate and ruined, from the tower of Syene to the border of Ethiopia.

verses.kjv: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.decoded: No human or animal will pass through it, and it will remain uninhabited for forty years.

verses.kjv: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.decoded: I will make Egypt a wasteland among other wastelands, and her cities will be ruined for forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them across the lands.

verses.kjv: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.decoded: But this is what the Sovereign LORD says: After forty years, I will bring the Egyptians back from the nations where they were scattered.

verses.kjv: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.decoded: I will restore Egypt’s captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros, their homeland, but they will be a lowly kingdom there.

verses.kjv: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.decoded: It will be the lowest of kingdoms and will never again rise above the other nations, because I will reduce them so they will no longer rule over the nations.

verses.kjv: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Egypt will no longer be a source of pride or security for Israel, reminding them of their sins when they think of it; instead, they will recognize that I am the Lord God.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the Lord spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
verses.decoded: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, used his army to attack Tyre fiercely—many were humiliated and injured—but he and his army received no payment or reward for their efforts against Tyre.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: I will give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. He will capture its people, plunder its wealth, and seize its goods as payment for his army.

verses.kjv: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I have given Egypt to him as payment for the work he did against it, because he served my purposes, declares the Lord God.

verses.kjv: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: On that day, I will cause Israel’s power to grow again, and I will give you the ability to speak boldly among them; then they will know that I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
verses.decoded: Son of man, deliver this prophecy: This is what the Sovereign LORD says—Cry out in sorrow, 'Woe to that day!'

verses.kjv: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
verses.decoded: The day is near—the day of the LORD is coming, a dark and cloudy day; it will be a time when foreign nations take control.

verses.kjv: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.decoded: War will strike Egypt, and great fear will spread in Ethiopia. Many will be killed in Egypt, its population will be taken away, and its foundations destroyed.

verses.kjv: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.decoded: Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all mixed peoples, Cush, and the allied nations will fall together by the sword.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Those who support Egypt will also fall; her proud strength will be brought low. From the border at Syene, they will be struck down by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.decoded: Egypt will become a wasteland among other wastelands, and her cities will lie in ruins among ruined cities.

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
verses.decoded: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set Egypt on fire and destroy all her allies.

verses.kjv: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
verses.decoded: On that day, I will send messengers by ship to frighten the careless Ethiopians, and great suffering will come upon them, just as it did in Egypt. Yes, it is coming.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will reduce Egypt’s population through Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.decoded: He and his armies—the most fearsome of nations—will come to destroy the land. They will attack Egypt with swords and fill the land with dead bodies.

verses.kjv: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: I will dry up the rivers and hand the land over to wicked people. I will make the land a wasteland, and everything in it will be destroyed by foreigners. I, the LORD, have declared it.
