verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will destroy the idols and images in Memphis (Noph). There will be no more rulers in Egypt, and I will bring fear to the land.

verses.kjv: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
verses.decoded: I will make Pathros a wasteland, set fire to Zoan, and bring judgment on Memphis (No).

verses.kjv: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.decoded: I will pour out my anger on Pelusium (Sin), Egypt’s stronghold, and I will destroy the population of Memphis (No).

verses.kjv: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
verses.decoded: I will bring destruction to Egypt: Sin will suffer greatly, and the city of No will be torn apart, and Noph will face troubles every day.

verses.kjv: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
verses.decoded: The young men of Aven (Heliopolis) and Pibeseth (Pubastum) will be killed by the sword, and these cities will be taken captive.

verses.kjv: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.decoded: At Tehaphnehes, the day will be darkened when I break Egypt’s control there; her proud strength will end, a cloud will cover her, and her dependent cities will be taken captive.

verses.kjv: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is how I will bring judgment on Egypt, and they will understand that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the eleventh year, during the first month on the seventh day, the LORD’s message came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
verses.decoded: Son of man, I have broken Pharaoh’s arm, the king of Egypt, and it will not be healed or properly bandaged to make it strong enough to hold a sword.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and I will break both his strong and weak arms, causing the sword to fall from his hand.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.decoded: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them throughout the lands.

verses.kjv: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
verses.decoded: I will strengthen the king of Babylon’s power and give him my sword, but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he will groan like a man mortally wounded before him.

verses.kjv: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: I will strengthen Babylon’s power, and Pharaoh’s power will fall; then they will know that I am the LORD when I give my sword to Babylon and he strikes Egypt.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them through the lands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
verses.decoded: Son of man, speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to his people: Who do you compare yourself to in your greatness?

verses.kjv: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
verses.decoded: Look, the Assyrian was like a tall cedar tree in Lebanon, with beautiful branches and a wide canopy, standing high with its top among thick branches.

verses.kjv: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
verses.decoded: The waters nourished him and the deep raised him high, with rivers flowing around his roots and sending small streams to all the trees in the field.

verses.kjv: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
verses.decoded: Because of the many waters, he grew taller than all the other trees, his branches multiplied and stretched out long when they grew.

verses.kjv: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
verses.decoded: All the birds of the sky nested in his branches, and all the wild animals gave birth under his shade; all the powerful nations lived in his shadow.

verses.kjv: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
verses.decoded: He was beautiful in his greatness and in the length of his branches because his roots were near abundant waters.

verses.kjv: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.
verses.decoded: Even the cedars in God’s garden couldn’t compare to him; the fir trees and chestnut trees didn’t match his branches; no tree in God’s garden was as beautiful as he was.

verses.kjv: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.
verses.decoded: I made him beautiful because of his many branches, so that all the trees of Eden in God’s garden envied him.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have raised yourself up high and your top has reached among the thick branches, and your heart is proud because of your height,

verses.kjv: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
verses.decoded: I have handed him over to a powerful foreign ruler who will punish him; I have removed him because of his wickedness.

verses.kjv: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
verses.decoded: Terrible foreigners from other nations have cut him down and abandoned him; his branches lie broken on the mountains and in the valleys, damaged by all the rivers; all the people who once lived under his shade have left him.

verses.kjv: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
verses.decoded: After his destruction, all the birds of the sky will live on his remains, and all the wild animals will be on his broken branches.

verses.kjv: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
verses.decoded: This is so that no tree growing near water will become proud because of its height or reach its top among thick branches; all trees that drink water are destined to die and go down to the grave among the people who descend to the pit.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day he went down to the grave, I caused mourning; I covered the deep and stopped the floods; the great waters were held back. Lebanon mourned for him, and all the trees of the field grew weak because of him.

verses.kjv: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
verses.decoded: I caused the nations to tremble when he fell, as I threw him down to the grave along with those who go down to the pit. All the great and beautiful trees of Eden, the finest of Lebanon that drink water, will find rest in the depths of the earth.

verses.kjv: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
verses.decoded: They went down to the grave with him, among those killed by the sword—his allies who lived under his protection among the nations.

verses.kjv: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Who else can compare to you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with those trees to the depths of the earth. You will lie among the uncircumcised, among those killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his army, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
verses.decoded: Son of man, mourn for Pharaoh king of Egypt and tell him: You are like a young lion among the nations, and like a great sea creature in the ocean. You came out with your rivers and stirred up the waters with your feet, polluting the rivers.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will spread my net over you, and many people will catch you in it and pull you up out of the water.

verses.kjv: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
verses.decoded: I will leave you on the land, throw you out into the open field, and the birds of the sky and the wild animals will feed on you.

verses.kjv: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
verses.decoded: I will spread your flesh over the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.

verses.kjv: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
verses.decoded: I will flood the land where you swam with your blood, even up to the mountains; the rivers will be filled with you.

verses.kjv: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
verses.decoded: When I destroy you, I will darken the sky, cover the stars, block the sun with clouds, and the moon will not shine.

verses.kjv: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will darken all the bright lights of the sky above you and bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
verses.decoded: I will stir up anger and grief in many nations when I bring your destruction to lands you have never known.

verses.kjv: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
verses.decoded: Many people will be shocked by you, and their kings will be terrified when I wield my sword against you; everyone will tremble for their lives on the day you fall.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will strike you.

verses.kjv: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
verses.decoded: I will use the swords of mighty warriors to bring down your great numbers, the fearsome warriors of many nations. They will plunder Egypt’s wealth, and all your people will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
verses.decoded: I will also kill all the animals near the great waters; no human or animal will disturb them anymore.

verses.kjv: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Then I will make the waters deep and cause the rivers to flow thick like oil, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: When I make Egypt a wasteland, empty of all its riches, and strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is the song of mourning they will sing for her: the nations’ daughters will mourn her; they will grieve for Egypt and all her people, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
verses.decoded: Son of man, mourn for the many people of Egypt; bring them down, including her and the daughters of famous nations, to the depths of the earth, to join those who descend into the grave.

verses.kjv: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
verses.decoded: Who do you compare yourself to in beauty? Go down and lie with the uncircumcised dead.

verses.kjv: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
verses.decoded: They will fall among those killed by the sword; she is handed over to the sword. Drag her and all her people down.

verses.kjv: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
verses.decoded: The strongest warriors will speak to him from the depths of the grave, with those who helped him. They have gone down, lying uncircumcised, killed by the sword.

verses.kjv: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
verses.decoded: Assyria is there with all its people; their graves surround them. All were killed, fallen by the sword.

verses.kjv: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: Their graves are on the edges of the pit, and their group surrounds the grave. All were killed, fallen by the sword, and they caused fear in the land of the living.

verses.kjv: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.decoded: Elam and all its people are there around its grave, all killed and fallen by the sword. They have gone down uncircumcised into the depths of the earth, causing fear in the land of the living, yet they carry their shame with those who go down to the grave.

verses.kjv: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
verses.decoded: They have prepared a resting place for her among the slain with all her people; her graves surround him. All are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Though they caused fear in the land of the living, they carry their shame with those who go down to the grave. He is placed among the slain.

verses.kjv: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: There are Meshech, Tubal, and all their people; their graves surround him. All are uncircumcised, killed by the sword, though they caused fear in the land of the living.

verses.kjv: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: They will not rest with the mighty fallen uncircumcised who went down to the grave with their weapons of war. They have placed their swords under their heads, but their sins remain on their bones, even though they terrified the mighty in the land of the living.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
verses.decoded: Yes, you will be broken among the uncircumcised and lie with those killed by the sword.

verses.kjv: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
verses.decoded: There is Edom, its kings and princes, who with their strength lie among those killed by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised and those who go down to the grave.

verses.kjv: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.decoded: There are the northern princes and all the Zidonians who have gone down with the slain. Though they caused fear, they are ashamed of their power; they lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and carry their shame with those who go down to the grave.

verses.kjv: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Pharaoh will see the dead bodies and feel some relief over the destruction of his army, including himself, all killed by the sword, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I have brought fear and destruction among the living, and Pharaoh along with his army will be buried among the uncircumcised dead who were killed by the sword, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Once more, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
verses.decoded: Son of man, tell the people of your nation: When I send an enemy to attack a land, and the people appoint someone from their borders to be their watchman,

verses.kjv: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
verses.decoded: if that watchman sees the sword coming and blows the trumpet to warn the people,

verses.kjv: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
verses.decoded: then anyone who hears the trumpet but does not take the warning, and the sword comes and kills him, will be responsible for his own death.

verses.kjv: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
verses.decoded: If someone hears the trumpet and ignores it, they are responsible for their own death. But anyone who listens and takes warning will save their life.

verses.kjv: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
verses.decoded: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people, and someone dies because of it, that person dies because of their own sin, but I will hold the watchman responsible for their death.

verses.kjv: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel. You must listen carefully to what I say and warn them on my behalf.

verses.kjv: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.decoded: If I tell you, 'You wicked person will die,' but you don’t warn that wicked person to turn from their ways, they will die because of their sin, and I will hold you responsible for their death.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.decoded: But if you warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they refuse, they will die because of their sin, but you will have saved yourself by giving the warning.

verses.kjv: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
verses.decoded: So, son of man, tell the people of Israel that they say, 'Our sins and wrongdoings are weighing us down and destroying us. Why should we bother trying to live?'

verses.kjv: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.decoded: Tell them, 'As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I do not want the wicked to die. I want them to turn from their evil ways and live. Turn away from your sins, Israel! Why choose death?'

verses.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
verses.decoded: So, son of man, tell the people that being righteous won’t save someone on the day they sin, and being wicked won’t cause someone to fall on the day they turn from their sin. Righteousness and wickedness are not guarantees in those moments.

verses.kjv: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
verses.decoded: If I say to a righteous person, 'You will live,' but they rely on their own goodness and then sin, their past righteousness will be forgotten, and they will die because of their sin.

verses.kjv: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
verses.decoded: And if I say to a wicked person, 'You will surely die,' but they turn away from their sin and do what is right and just,

verses.kjv: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.decoded: if the wicked person returns what they took, follows the laws of life, and stops sinning, they will live and not die.

verses.kjv: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verses.decoded: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him; he has done what is right and just, so he will surely live.

verses.kjv: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
verses.decoded: But your people say, ‘God’s way is unfair,’ yet their own ways are not fair.

verses.kjv: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
verses.decoded: When a righteous person stops doing right and commits sin, they will die because of it.

verses.kjv: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
verses.decoded: But if a wicked person turns away from sin and does what is right, they will live.

verses.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
verses.decoded: But you say, ‘God’s way is unfair.’ People of Israel, I will judge each of you according to your own actions.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
verses.decoded: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the tenth month, fifth day, someone escaped from Jerusalem and told me, ‘The city has been attacked.’

verses.kjv: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
verses.decoded: God’s power came upon me the evening before the escapee arrived; He kept me silent until morning, then I was able to speak again.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
verses.decoded: Son of man, the people living in the ruined land of Israel say, ‘Abraham was one person and inherited the land, but we are many, so the land belongs to us.’

verses.kjv: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: You eat food made with blood, worship idols, and shed blood—will you really own this land?’

verses.kjv: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?
verses.decoded: You live by the sword, commit disgusting acts, and each of you defiles your neighbor’s wife—will you truly possess the land?

verses.kjv: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘As surely as I live,’ says the Lord God, ‘those in the ruins will die by the sword, those in the open fields will be killed by wild animals, and those in forts and caves will die from disease.’

verses.kjv: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
verses.decoded: I will make the land completely desolate; its proud strength will end, and the mountains of Israel will be so empty that no one will travel through them.

verses.kjv: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
verses.decoded: Then they will know that I am the Lord when I have made the land desolate because of all their terrible sins.

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.
verses.decoded: Son of man, your people still talk about you near the walls and doorways, whispering to each other, ‘Come, listen to what the Lord is saying.’

verses.kjv: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
verses.decoded: They come to you like the people usually do, and they sit before you as if you were their leader. They listen to your words, but they don’t follow them. With their words, they show great love, but their hearts are focused on greed.

verses.kjv: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verses.decoded: You are like a beautiful song sung by someone with a pleasant voice who plays an instrument skillfully. They hear your words, but they don’t put them into practice.

verses.kjv: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
verses.decoded: When these things actually happen—and they will—then they will realize that a prophet was truly among them.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
verses.decoded: Son of man, speak against the leaders of Israel. Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the leaders: Woe to those leaders who take care of themselves instead of the flock! Shouldn't leaders take care of their people?’

verses.kjv: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
verses.decoded: You eat the best parts, wear the wool for yourselves, and kill the healthy animals—but you don’t take care of the flock.

verses.kjv: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
verses.decoded: You have not helped the weak or healed the sick. You didn’t care for the injured, bring back those who wandered off, or search for the lost. Instead, you ruled them harshly and with cruelty.

verses.kjv: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
verses.decoded: Because there was no shepherd, the sheep were scattered and became food for wild animals.

verses.kjv: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
verses.decoded: My sheep wandered everywhere—across all the mountains and hills. My flock was scattered all over the earth, and no one looked for them or tried to bring them back.

verses.kjv: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
verses.decoded: So, leaders, listen to what the LORD says:

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
verses.decoded: I swear by my life, declares the Sovereign LORD, because my flock was left to be eaten by wild animals—because there was no shepherd and my leaders didn’t look after them but only cared for themselves—

verses.kjv: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
verses.decoded: So, leaders, listen carefully to the word of the LORD:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against the leaders. I will hold them accountable for my flock. I will stop them from feeding the flock, and they will no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their control so they won’t be eaten by them.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.

verses.kjv: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.decoded: Just as a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep during the day, I will search for my sheep and rescue them from all the places where they have been scattered on dark and cloudy days.

verses.kjv: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.decoded: I will bring them out from among the nations and gather them from the countries. I will bring them back to their own land, where I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, near rivers and in all the inhabited places.

verses.kjv: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.decoded: I will feed them in rich pastures. Their home will be on the high mountains of Israel, where they will rest in a safe place and eat from lush pastures.

verses.kjv: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will take care of my flock and let them rest peacefully, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verses.decoded: I will search for the lost sheep, bring back those who were scattered, heal the injured, and strengthen the weak. But I will punish the proud and powerful, feeding them with justice.

verses.kjv: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
verses.decoded: Listen, my people, says the Lord GOD: I will judge fairly between one group and another, like separating sheep from goats.

verses.kjv: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.decoded: Is it not enough that you have eaten all the best grass, but you also trample what’s left? You drink the clean water, yet spoil the rest with your feet?

verses.kjv: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
verses.decoded: My people have to eat the grass you have trampled and drink the water you have polluted.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
verses.decoded: So says the Lord GOD: I myself will judge between the strong and the weak.

verses.kjv: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
verses.decoded: You have pushed and shoved with your horns, driving away the sick and weak until they were scattered everywhere.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I will rescue my people so they will no longer be victims, and I will judge fairly among them.

verses.kjv: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.decoded: I will appoint one leader over them, my servant David, who will care for and guide them.

verses.kjv: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David will be their leader. This is my declaration.

verses.kjv: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.decoded: I will make a peaceful agreement with them, remove dangerous animals from the land, and they will live safely in the wilderness and forests.

verses.kjv: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.decoded: I will bless them and the land around my holy mountain, sending timely rains and abundant blessings.

verses.kjv: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
verses.decoded: Trees will bear fruit, the land will produce crops, and they will live safely, knowing I am the LORD after I break their chains and rescue them from those who exploited them.

verses.kjv: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.decoded: They will no longer be victims of foreign enemies or wild animals; they will live safely without fear.

verses.kjv: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
verses.decoded: I will raise up a famous leader for them, and they will no longer suffer hunger or be ashamed before other nations.

verses.kjv: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Then they will understand that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the people of Israel, are my own, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You are my flock, the people I care for like a shepherd cares for his sheep, and I am your God, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Also, the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to Mount Seir and deliver a prophecy against it,

verses.kjv: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
verses.decoded: Say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Look, Mount Seir, I am against you. I will reach out my hand to destroy you and leave you completely ruined.’

verses.kjv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will destroy your cities, leaving you desolate, and you will understand that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
verses.decoded: Because you have always hated Israel and have killed their people with your sword when they were suffering and at the end of their punishment,

verses.kjv: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
verses.decoded: I swear by my life, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will bring violence upon you, and violence will chase you because you have not hated violence; violence will now hunt you down.

verses.kjv: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
verses.decoded: I will make Mount Seir completely desolate and will destroy everyone who comes and goes there.

verses.kjv: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.decoded: I will cover its mountains with the bodies of the dead; in your hills, valleys, and rivers, those killed by the sword will fall.

verses.kjv: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will cause you to be desolate forever; your cities will never be rebuilt, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
verses.decoded: Because you said, ‘These two nations and their lands will be mine, and we will take possession of them,’ even though the LORD was there,

verses.kjv: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
verses.decoded: I swear by my life, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will repay you for your anger and envy, which you showed because of your hatred against them. I will reveal myself to them when I punish you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
verses.decoded: You will know that I am the LORD because I have heard all the insults you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They are ruined and given to us to take over.’

verses.kjv: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
verses.decoded: You have bragged against me with your words and increased your insults, but I have heard everything.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.decoded: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When the whole earth celebrates, I will make you desolate.

verses.kjv: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Just as you were happy when Israel’s land was ruined, so I will do the same to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all of Edom will be destroyed. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.decoded: Son of man, speak to the mountains of Israel and tell them, 'Mountains of Israel, listen to what the Lord says.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
verses.decoded: The Sovereign Lord says: Because your enemies have mocked you, saying, 'Ha! The old sacred places belong to us now,'

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
verses.decoded: Proclaim this message: The Lord says, Because others have destroyed you and taken over your land on all sides, making you a possession for the remaining nations, and because people gossip about you and you have become a disgrace among the nations,

verses.kjv: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
verses.decoded: Mountains of Israel, listen to the Lord’s message. The Lord speaks to the mountains, hills, valleys, rivers, wastelands, and abandoned cities that have become a spoil and a mockery to the surrounding nations.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.decoded: The Lord says: Because of my fierce jealousy, I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Edom, who took my land with full joy and hateful hearts, treating it as their spoil.

verses.kjv: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
verses.decoded: So prophesy about the land of Israel and say to the mountains, hills, rivers, and valleys: The Lord says, I have spoken in my jealousy and anger because you have suffered the shame caused by the nations.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.decoded: The Lord declares: I have sworn that the nations around you will themselves be put to shame.

verses.kjv: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.decoded: But you, mountains of Israel, will grow branches and produce fruit for my people Israel, because they are coming back soon.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
verses.decoded: I am with you and will turn to you; you will be cultivated and planted again.

verses.kjv: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
verses.decoded: I will increase the population of Israel on your land; all of Israel will return. The cities will be lived in again, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will increase both people and animals on your land; they will multiply and be fruitful. I will restore you to your former lands and bless you even more than before. Then you will know that I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
verses.decoded: My people Israel will live on your land and possess it as their inheritance. You will no longer cause them to lose people.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
verses.decoded: The Lord says: Because people accuse you, saying, 'You consume people and have destroyed your nations,'

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will no longer consume people or cause your nations to fall, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will no longer let people hear the shame of the nations in you. You will no longer carry the disgrace of the peoples or cause your nations to fall, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
verses.decoded: Son of man, when Israel lived in their own land, they polluted it by their actions and behavior; their conduct was like the impurity of a woman who has been divorced.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
verses.decoded: So I unleashed my anger on them because they shed blood in the land and defiled it with their idols.

verses.kjv: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.decoded: I scattered them among the nations, spreading them across different countries, judging them according to their behavior and actions.

verses.kjv: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.decoded: When they went among the nations, they dishonored my holy name by saying to others, ‘These are the people of the LORD who left his land.’

verses.kjv: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
verses.decoded: But I felt compassion for my holy name, which Israel had dishonored among the nations where they were scattered.

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
verses.decoded: So tell Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am not doing this for your benefit, Israel, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have dishonored among the nations where you were scattered.’

verses.kjv: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.decoded: I will make my great name holy again, which you have dishonored among the nations. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, when I make myself holy through you in their sight, declares the Sovereign LORD.

verses.kjv: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.decoded: I will bring you back from the nations and gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you back to your own land.

verses.kjv: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.decoded: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be purified from all your impurities and from all your idols.

verses.kjv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.decoded: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you. I will remove your hard, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.

verses.kjv: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
verses.decoded: I will put my Spirit inside you and make you follow my laws and obey my rules.

verses.kjv: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.decoded: You will live in the land I gave to your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.kjv: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.decoded: I will rescue you from all your impurities. I will call for grain and increase it so you will never suffer famine again.

verses.kjv: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
verses.decoded: I will increase the fruit of your trees and the crops in your fields, so you will no longer be ashamed by famine among the nations.

verses.kjv: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.decoded: Then you will remember your own evil actions and bad deeds, and you will feel disgusted with yourselves because of your sins and terrible offenses.

verses.kjv: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
verses.decoded: I am not doing this for your benefit, declares the Lord GOD. You should be ashamed and embarrassed because of your own behavior, O people of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will let you live in the cities again, and the ruined places will be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.decoded: The empty land that was abandoned and seen as worthless by everyone passing through will be cultivated and farmed.

verses.kjv: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.decoded: People will say, 'This land that was empty has become like the garden of Eden; the ruined and abandoned cities are now protected and lived in.'

verses.kjv: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.decoded: Then the nations around you will realize that I, the LORD, am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and planted what was empty. I have declared it, and I will do it.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD says: Because of this, the people of Israel will seek me, and I will do this for them. I will multiply their numbers like a flock of sheep.

verses.kjv: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: Just as the holy flock gathers in Jerusalem during special festivals, so the empty cities will be filled with people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.decoded: God's power came over me, and He took me in His Spirit to a valley filled with many bones.

verses.kjv: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.decoded: He led me all around the valley, and I saw that there were countless bones lying there, very dry and lifeless.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
verses.decoded: He asked me, 'Human one, can these bones live again?' I replied, 'Lord God, only You know.'

verses.kjv: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then He told me to speak to the bones and say, 'Dry bones, listen to what the Lord says!'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.decoded: God said to the bones, 'Look, I will breathe life into you, and you will live again.'

verses.kjv: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will put muscles on you, cover you with flesh and skin, breathe life into you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.decoded: I spoke as I was told, and suddenly there was a noise and shaking as the bones joined together, connecting bone to bone.

verses.kjv: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
verses.decoded: I saw muscles and flesh form on the bones, skin covered them, but there was no breath in them yet.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.decoded: Then He told me, 'Speak to the wind, human one, and say, "This is what the Lord says: Come from all directions, breath, and breathe life into these dead bodies so they may live."'

verses.kjv: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.decoded: I spoke as He commanded, and breath entered them. They came to life and stood up—a huge army.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Human one, these bones represent all of Israel. They say, "Our bones are dried up, our hope is gone, and we are finished."'

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.decoded: So prophesy and tell them, 'This is what the Lord says: I will open your graves and bring you back to life, and bring you back to the land of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
verses.decoded: Then you will know that I am the Lord when I bring you out of your graves, my people.

verses.kjv: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. I will settle you in your own land, and then you will know that I, the Lord, have said it and done it.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The Lord spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:
verses.decoded: Son of man, take one stick and write on it 'For Judah and the people of Israel who belong to him.' Then take another stick and write on it 'For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the people of Israel who belong to him.'

verses.kjv: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
verses.decoded: Join the two sticks together so they become one stick in your hand.

verses.kjv: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
verses.decoded: When the people ask you, 'What do these sticks mean?'

verses.kjv: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
verses.decoded: Tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will take the stick of Joseph, representing Ephraim and the other tribes of Israel, and join it with the stick of Judah. I will make them one stick in my hand.'

verses.kjv: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
verses.decoded: The sticks you write on will be in your hand for everyone to see.

verses.kjv: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
verses.decoded: Tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring the people of Israel back from the nations where they have been scattered, and gather them from all around to their own land.'

verses.kjv: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
verses.decoded: I will make them one nation in the land of Israel’s mountains, with one king ruling over all of them. They will no longer be two separate nations or divided kingdoms.

verses.kjv: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.decoded: They will no longer pollute themselves with idols or detestable things or sins. I will rescue them from all the places where they have sinned and purify them. Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.kjv: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.decoded: David my servant will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws, obey my rules, and live by them.

verses.kjv: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
verses.decoded: They will live in the land I gave to Jacob my servant, where your ancestors lived. They will live there forever, along with their children and grandchildren. David my servant will be their eternal leader.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.decoded: I will make a covenant of peace with them—an everlasting agreement. I will settle them, increase their numbers, and place my sanctuary among them forever.

verses.kjv: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.decoded: My dwelling place will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.decoded: The nations will know that I, the LORD, have made Israel holy when my sanctuary is among them forever.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.decoded: Son of man, turn your attention to Gog from the land of Magog, the main leader of Meshech and Tubal, and speak a prophecy against him.

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.decoded: Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Gog, the chief leader of Meshech and Tubal.’

verses.kjv: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
verses.decoded: I will make you turn around and lead you out with hooks in your jaws. I will bring you and your entire army—horses and riders—all fully armed with shields and swords, a large and well-equipped force.

verses.kjv: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
verses.decoded: Persia, Cush (Ethiopia), and Put (Libya) will join them, all wearing shields and helmets.

verses.kjv: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.
verses.decoded: Gomer and all its troops, along with the people of Togarmah from the north and all their troops, will be with you—many nations in total.

verses.kjv: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.
verses.decoded: Get ready and prepare yourself and all your gathered troops. Be their leader and protector.

verses.kjv: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
verses.decoded: After a long time, you will be summoned to invade a land restored from war and repopulated from many nations—the mountains of Israel, which were once desolate but now inhabited safely by many people.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.
verses.decoded: You will come like a storm, like a thick cloud covering the land, along with all your troops and many people.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
verses.decoded: The Sovereign LORD says: At that time, you will devise an evil plan and think about doing something harmful.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
verses.decoded: You will say, ‘I will attack a land of peaceful villages without walls, where people live safely and without defenses like gates or bars.’

verses.kjv: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
verses.decoded: You plan to plunder and seize goods from once-deserted places now inhabited by people gathered from many nations, who have livestock and possessions and live in the center of the land.

verses.kjv: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
verses.decoded: Sheba, Dedan, and the traders from Tarshish and their allies will ask you, ‘Have you come to steal? Have you gathered your troops to loot silver, gold, cattle, and goods?’

verses.kjv: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
verses.decoded: So, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day when my people Israel live safely, will you not know it?’

verses.kjv: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
verses.decoded: You will come from your land in the far north with many people, all riding horses—a large and powerful army.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
verses.decoded: You will come against my people Israel like a cloud covering the land; this will happen in the last days. I will bring you against my land so that the nations will recognize me when I show my holiness through you, O Gog, right before their eyes.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?
verses.decoded: The Sovereign LORD says: Are you the one I spoke about long ago through my servants the prophets of Israel? They predicted many years ago that I would bring you against them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.
verses.decoded: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD, my anger will flare up.

verses.kjv: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
verses.decoded: Because of my jealousy and burning anger, I declare that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

verses.kjv: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
verses.decoded: All creatures—fish in the sea, birds in the sky, wild animals, insects, and every person on earth—will tremble in my presence. Mountains will collapse, cliffs will fall, and every wall will crumble to the ground.

verses.kjv: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man’s sword shall be against his brother.
verses.decoded: I will summon weapons against him across all my mountains, declares the Sovereign LORD. Everyone will fight against their own relatives.

verses.kjv: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.decoded: I will bring disease and bloodshed against him. I will pour down heavy rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him, his troops, and all the many people with him.

verses.kjv: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: In this way, I will show my greatness and holiness. Many nations will see this and recognize that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.decoded: Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.'

verses.kjv: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
verses.decoded: I will turn you around and leave only one-sixth of your forces. I will bring you from the far north and lead you onto the mountains of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
verses.decoded: I will destroy your weapons; your bow will be taken from your left hand and your arrows will drop from your right hand.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
verses.decoded: You and all your troops will fall on the mountains of Israel. I will give you to the birds and wild animals to be eaten.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will fall in the open fields because I have declared it, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will send fire on Magog and on those living confidently in the distant islands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.decoded: I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I will protect my name from being dishonored, and the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
verses.decoded: Look, it has happened and is finished, says the Lord GOD; this is the day I spoke about.

verses.kjv: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
verses.decoded: The people living in Israel’s cities will go out and burn the weapons—shields, bucklers, bows, arrows, javelins, and spears—and they will burn them for seven years.
