verses.kjv: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: They will not need to take wood from fields or forests because they will burn the weapons for fuel. They will take back from those who plundered them, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamongog.
verses.decoded: On that day, I will give Gog a burial place in Israel—the valley of those who travel east of the sea. It will block the travelers’ path. There they will bury Gog and all his army, and the place will be called the Valley of Hamongog (the multitude of Gog).

verses.kjv: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel will spend seven months burying the dead to cleanse the land.

verses.kjv: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Everyone in the land will help bury the dead, and that day will be remembered as the day I am glorified, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
verses.decoded: They will appoint men who work continuously to travel through the land and bury any remaining bodies with those already buried, to cleanse the land. After seven months, they will search again.

verses.kjv: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.
verses.decoded: Travelers passing through the land who see a bone will mark the spot until the burial teams can bury it in the Valley of Hamongog.

verses.kjv: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
verses.decoded: The city will be called Hamonah, meaning 'The Multitude.' This is how they will cleanse the land.

verses.kjv: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
verses.decoded: Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Tell every bird and wild animal to come together and gather around my great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, so you can eat flesh and drink blood.

verses.kjv: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
verses.decoded: You will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the leaders of the earth—rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all well-fed from Bashan.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
verses.decoded: You will eat until you are full and drink blood until you are drunk from the sacrifice I have made for you.

verses.kjv: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: At my table, you will be filled with horses, chariots, mighty warriors, and all soldiers, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
verses.decoded: I will reveal my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment I have carried out and the power I have used against them.

verses.kjv: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
verses.decoded: From that day forward, the people of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
verses.decoded: The nations will understand that Israel was taken captive because of their sins. Because they rebelled against me, I turned away and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.

verses.kjv: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
verses.decoded: I treated them according to their sins and impurities, and I turned away from them.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will restore Jacob’s captivity, show mercy to all Israel, and be zealous for my holy name.

verses.kjv: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
verses.decoded: After they have endured their shame and the consequences of their sins against me, when they live safely in their land without fear.

verses.kjv: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
verses.decoded: When I bring them back from among the nations and gather them from their enemies’ lands, and show that I am holy through them before many nations.

verses.kjv: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
verses.decoded: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, who allowed them to be taken captive among the nations, but I have now gathered them back to their own land and left none behind.

verses.kjv: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: I will no longer turn away from them because I have poured out my Spirit on the people of Israel, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.
verses.decoded: In the 25th year of our exile, at the start of the year, on the 10th day of the month, which was 14 years after the city was destroyed, on that very day the LORD's power came upon me and brought me there.

verses.kjv: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
verses.decoded: In a vision from God, He took me to the land of Israel and placed me on a very high mountain that looked like the outline of a city to the south.

verses.kjv: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
verses.decoded: He brought me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like polished bronze, holding a measuring line and a measuring rod, standing at the gate.

verses.kjv: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: The man said to me, 'Son of man, look carefully, listen closely, and pay attention to everything I show you. You were brought here so I could show these things to you. Tell the people of Israel everything you see.'

verses.kjv: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
verses.decoded: I saw a wall surrounding the outside of the temple, and the man held a measuring rod six cubits long (a cubit plus a handbreadth). He measured the building’s width and height, each one reed long.

verses.kjv: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
verses.decoded: Then he went to the gate facing east, climbed its stairs, and measured the gate’s threshold, which was one reed wide on both sides.

verses.kjv: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
verses.decoded: Each small room was one reed long and one reed wide, with five cubits between the rooms. The threshold by the gate’s inner porch was one reed wide.

verses.kjv: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
verses.decoded: He also measured the gate’s inner porch, which was one reed wide.

verses.kjv: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
verses.decoded: Then he measured the gate’s porch: it was eight cubits deep, with posts two cubits wide, and the porch faced inward.

verses.kjv: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
verses.decoded: On the east side of the gate, there were three small rooms on each side, all the same size. The posts on both sides were also the same size.

verses.kjv: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.decoded: He measured the gate’s entrance width as ten cubits, and its length as thirteen cubits.

verses.kjv: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
verses.decoded: There was a one-cubit space in front of the small rooms on each side, and the rooms themselves were six cubits wide on each side.

verses.kjv: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
verses.decoded: He measured the gate from the roof of one small room to the roof of the opposite one; the width was twenty-five cubits, with doors facing each other.

verses.kjv: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
verses.decoded: He also made posts sixty cubits high, reaching to the posts of the courtyard surrounding the gate.

verses.kjv: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
verses.decoded: The distance from the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner gate’s porch was fifty cubits.

verses.kjv: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.
verses.decoded: There were small, narrow windows in the small rooms and on the posts inside the gate all around, as well as on the porches. Windows were all around on the inside, and each post had palm tree decorations.

verses.kjv: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
verses.decoded: Then he took me into the outer courtyard, where there were rooms and a paved area all around; thirty rooms were built on this pavement.

verses.kjv: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
verses.decoded: The pavement next to the gates, along the length of the gates, was called the lower pavement.

verses.kjv: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
verses.decoded: He measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court outside, which was one hundred cubits toward the east and north.

verses.kjv: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
verses.decoded: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer courtyard that faced north.

verses.kjv: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.decoded: There were three small rooms on each side of the gate. The posts and porches were the same size as those of the first gate. The gate was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
verses.decoded: Their windows, porches, and palm tree decorations matched those of the east-facing gate. Seven steps led up to it, and the porches were in front of the steps.

verses.kjv: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: The inner court gate was opposite the north gate and toward the east; the distance between these gates was one hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
verses.decoded: Then he took me toward the south, where there was a gate facing south, and he measured its posts and porches using the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.decoded: It had windows all around, including on the porches, similar to the other gates. Its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.

verses.kjv: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
verses.decoded: Seven steps led up to the gate, with porches in front of the steps. Palm tree decorations were on the posts, one on each side.

verses.kjv: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: There was a gate in the inner court facing south, and the distance from gate to gate in that direction was one hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
verses.decoded: He took me to the inner court through the south gate and measured that gate using the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.decoded: Its small rooms, posts, and porches were measured the same way. It had windows all around, including on the porches. The gate was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
verses.decoded: The porches all around were twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.decoded: The arches faced the outer courtyard, and palm tree designs were on the posts. There were eight steps leading up to it.

verses.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
verses.decoded: He took me into the inner courtyard on the east side and measured the gate using these same dimensions.

verses.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.decoded: The small rooms, posts, and arches matched these measurements. There were windows all around, including in the arches. The structure was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.decoded: The arches faced the outer courtyard, with palm tree decorations on the posts on both sides. There were eight steps leading up to it.

verses.kjv: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;
verses.decoded: He took me to the north gate and measured it using the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.decoded: The small rooms, posts, arches, and surrounding windows measured fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.decoded: The posts faced the outer courtyard, with palm tree decorations on both sides. There were eight steps leading up to it.

verses.kjv: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
verses.decoded: The rooms and entrances near the gate posts were where they washed the burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
verses.decoded: In the gate's porch, there were two tables on each side used for slaughtering burnt, sin, and trespass offerings.

verses.kjv: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
verses.decoded: Outside, near the entrance to the north gate, there were two tables on one side and two more on the other side at the gate's porch.

verses.kjv: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
verses.decoded: There were four tables on each side of the gate, making eight tables total, where sacrifices were slaughtered.

verses.kjv: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.decoded: Four of the tables were made of carved stone for burnt offerings, measuring one and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one cubit high. They also held the tools used for slaughtering.

verses.kjv: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
verses.decoded: Inside, there were hooks about a hand's width attached all around, and the offering's flesh was placed on the tables.

verses.kjv: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
verses.decoded: Outside the inner gate, near the north gate in the inner court, were the rooms for the singers, facing south. Another was near the east gate, facing north.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
verses.decoded: He told me that the room facing south was for the priests who were responsible for managing the temple.

verses.kjv: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
verses.decoded: The room facing north is for the priests who are responsible for the altar. These priests are the descendants of Zadok from the tribe of Levi, who are allowed to serve the LORD directly.

verses.kjv: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
verses.decoded: He measured the courtyard, which was 100 cubits long and 100 cubits wide, forming a perfect square, along with the altar located in front of the temple.

verses.kjv: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
verses.decoded: He took me to the temple porch and measured each post: five cubits on one side and five on the other. The gate was three cubits wide on each side.

verses.kjv: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
verses.decoded: The porch was 20 cubits long and 11 cubits wide. He showed me the steps leading up to it, and there were pillars next to the posts—one on each side.

verses.kjv: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: Then he took me to the temple and measured the doorposts, which were six cubits wide on each side, matching the width of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
verses.decoded: The doorway was ten cubits wide, with five cubits on each side. He measured the length as forty cubits and the width as twenty cubits.

verses.kjv: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
verses.decoded: Then he went inside and measured the doorpost at two cubits, the door itself at six cubits, and the total width of the doorway at seven cubits.

verses.kjv: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
verses.decoded: He measured the area in front of the temple as twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide, and said to me, 'This is the most holy place.'

verses.kjv: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
verses.decoded: Then he measured the temple wall at six cubits thick, and each side chamber around the temple was four cubits wide.

verses.kjv: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
verses.decoded: The side chambers were arranged in three levels, one above the other, with thirty chambers in total. They were built into the temple wall for support, but they were not part of the main wall structure.

verses.kjv: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
verses.decoded: There was a widening and a continuous spiral going upward to the side chambers, so the temple’s width increased gradually from the lowest to the highest chamber.

verses.kjv: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
verses.decoded: I also saw that the height of the temple all around was equal to a reed measuring six large cubits, which was the height of the side chambers’ foundations.

verses.kjv: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.
verses.decoded: The outer wall supporting the side chambers was five cubits thick, and the remaining space inside was used for the side chambers themselves.

verses.kjv: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
verses.decoded: There was a space twenty cubits wide between the side chambers all around the temple.

verses.kjv: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
verses.decoded: The side chambers had doors opening to the central open space, with one door facing north and another facing south. This open space was five cubits wide all around.

verses.kjv: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
verses.decoded: The structure in front of the special area at the western end was seventy cubits wide, with walls five cubits thick all around, and it was ninety cubits long.

verses.kjv: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
verses.decoded: He measured the temple building as one hundred cubits long, including the special area and the adjoining building with its walls.

verses.kjv: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: The width of the front of the temple and the special area on the east side was one hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
verses.decoded: He measured the length of the building opposite the special area behind it, including the galleries on both sides, the inner temple, and the court porches, all as one hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;
verses.decoded: The doorposts, narrow windows, and the balconies all around on three levels opposite the door were all covered with wood from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered.

verses.kjv: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
verses.decoded: From above the door to the inner sanctuary, both inside and outside, all the walls around were measured carefully.

verses.kjv: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
verses.decoded: The walls were decorated with cherubim and palm trees, with a palm tree placed between each pair of cherubim; each cherub had two faces.

verses.kjv: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.
verses.decoded: One face of the cherub was that of a man looking toward one palm tree, and the other face was a young lion looking toward the other palm tree; this design went all around the temple.

verses.kjv: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
verses.decoded: Cherubim and palm trees were carved from the floor up to above the door and on the temple walls.

verses.kjv: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
verses.decoded: The temple’s doorposts were square, and the front of the sanctuary looked the same as the doorposts.

verses.kjv: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD.
verses.decoded: The wooden altar was three cubits high and two cubits long; its corners, length, and walls were all made of wood. He said to me, 'This is the table that stands before the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
verses.decoded: Both the temple and the sanctuary each had two doors.

verses.kjv: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
verses.decoded: Each door had two panels that swung open; two panels for one door and two for the other.

verses.kjv: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
verses.decoded: The temple doors were decorated with cherubim and palm trees like those on the walls, and thick wooden planks covered the outside of the porch.

verses.kjv: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
verses.decoded: There were narrow windows and palm tree decorations on both sides of the porch and on the side rooms of the building, along with thick wooden planks.

verses.kjv: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
verses.decoded: Then he took me out into the outer courtyard, heading north. He led me to the chamber that was opposite the separate area, located in front of the building on the north side.

verses.kjv: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
verses.decoded: The north door was 100 cubits long and 50 cubits wide.

verses.kjv: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.decoded: Opposite the 20 cubits of the inner court and opposite the pavement of the outer court, there were galleries facing each other in three levels.

verses.kjv: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
verses.decoded: In front of the chambers was a 10-cubit-wide walkway inside, with a 1-cubit-wide path, and their doors faced north.

verses.kjv: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
verses.decoded: The upper chambers were smaller because the galleries were taller than the lower and middle parts of the building.

verses.kjv: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
verses.decoded: The chambers had three levels but no pillars like those in the courts, so the building was narrower than the lower and middle sections from the ground up.

verses.kjv: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
verses.decoded: The outer wall facing the chambers, toward the outer court in front of the chambers, was 50 cubits long.

verses.kjv: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: The chambers in the outer court were 50 cubits long, and in front of the temple was 100 cubits.

verses.kjv: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
verses.decoded: There was an entrance on the east side beneath these chambers, allowing access from the outer court.

verses.kjv: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
verses.decoded: The chambers were built into the thick eastern wall of the court, opposite the separate area and the main building.

verses.kjv: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
verses.decoded: The walkway in front of these chambers looked like the chambers on the north side, matching their length and width. All exits were designed according to their style and doors.

verses.kjv: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
verses.decoded: Matching the doors of the southern chambers, there was a door at the end of the walkway, directly in front of the eastern wall, as one enters the chambers.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
verses.decoded: He told me that the north and south chambers in front of the separate area are holy rooms where priests who serve the LORD will eat the most sacred offerings. They will store the most holy items, the grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings there because the place is holy.

verses.kjv: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
verses.decoded: When priests enter these chambers, they must not leave the holy area to go into the outer court while wearing their sacred garments. Instead, they will remove those garments there and put on different clothes before approaching the areas designated for the people.

verses.kjv: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
verses.decoded: After finishing the measurements of the inner temple, he took me out toward the gate facing east and measured it all around.

verses.kjv: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.decoded: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred rods long, measuring all around.

verses.kjv: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.decoded: He measured the north side, which was also five hundred rods long, measuring all around.

verses.kjv: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
verses.decoded: He measured the south side, and it was five hundred rods long.

verses.kjv: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.decoded: He turned to the west side and measured it; it was also five hundred rods long.

verses.kjv: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
verses.decoded: He measured all four sides; the area was enclosed by a wall, five hundred rods long and five hundred rods wide, to separate the holy sanctuary from the common area.

verses.kjv: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:
verses.decoded: Then he brought me to the gate that faces east.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, the glory of the God of Israel came from the east. His voice sounded like the roar of many waters, and the earth was bright with his glory.

verses.kjv: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.decoded: This vision looked like the one I saw before, the same as when I came to destroy the city. It was like the vision I had by the river Chebar, and I fell face down.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
verses.decoded: The glory of the LORD entered the temple through the east gate.

verses.kjv: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner courtyard, and I saw that the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

verses.kjv: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
verses.decoded: I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple, and the man who had been with me stood beside me.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Son of man, this is where my throne will be and where I will rest my feet. I will live among the people of Israel forever. They and their kings will no longer dishonor my holy name by their sins or by the bodies of their kings who were sacrificed on their high places.'

verses.kjv: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
verses.decoded: They placed their doorframes next to mine and their walls next to mine, separating me from them by only a wall. Yet they defiled my holy name with their evil acts, so I destroyed them in my anger.

verses.kjv: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
verses.decoded: Now they must stop their sinful ways and remove the bodies of their kings from my presence, and then I will live among them forever.

verses.kjv: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
verses.decoded: Son of man, show the temple to the people of Israel so they will feel ashamed of their sins. Have them carefully measure its design.

verses.kjv: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
verses.decoded: If they feel sorry for what they have done, show them the temple’s design, its layout, entrances and exits, all its details, rules, and regulations. Write it down so they can follow all the instructions and obey them.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
verses.decoded: This is the law for the temple: the entire area on the mountain will be most holy all around. This is the law for the temple.

verses.kjv: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
verses.decoded: Here are the altar’s measurements in cubits: a cubit is a cubit plus a handbreadth. The base will be one cubit high and one cubit wide, with a rim around it about a span wide. This will be the altar’s top platform.

verses.kjv: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
verses.decoded: From the ground to the lower ledge will be two cubits high and one cubit wide; from the lower ledge to the upper ledge will be four cubits high and one cubit wide.

verses.kjv: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
verses.decoded: The altar will be four cubits high, with four horns extending upward from it.

verses.kjv: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
verses.decoded: The altar will be twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide, perfectly square in shape.

verses.kjv: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
verses.decoded: The platform will be fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, square in shape; it will have a half-cubit border around it and a base one cubit high. The stairs will face east.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
verses.decoded: The Lord says, 'Son of man, these are the rules for the altar on the day it is made, for offering burnt sacrifices and sprinkling blood on it.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: You must give the priests from the Levites descended from Zadok, who serve me, a young bull as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
verses.decoded: Take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, the four corners of the platform, and the border all around to cleanse and purify it.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The bull used for the sin offering must be burned in the designated place outside the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
verses.decoded: On the second day, offer a flawless young goat as a sin offering and cleanse the altar the same way you did with the bull.

verses.kjv: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
verses.decoded: After finishing the cleansing, offer a flawless young bull and a flawless ram from the flock.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Offer these animals before the Lord; the priests will sprinkle salt on them and burn them as burnt offerings to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
verses.decoded: For seven days, prepare a goat for a sin offering each day, along with a flawless young bull and a flawless ram from the flock.

verses.kjv: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
verses.decoded: They will purify and cleanse the altar for seven days and consecrate themselves.

verses.kjv: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: After these seven days, starting on the eighth day, the priests will offer your burnt and peace (thank) offerings on the altar, and I will accept you, says the Lord God.

verses.kjv: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
verses.decoded: Then he led me back to the gate of the outer sanctuary that faces east, and it was closed.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to me, 'This gate must remain shut and never be opened. No one may enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore, it must stay closed.'

verses.kjv: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
verses.decoded: This gate is for the prince. The prince will sit there to eat in the presence of the LORD. He will enter and exit through the porch of this gate.

verses.kjv: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
verses.decoded: Then he led me to the north gate in front of the temple, and I saw the glory of the LORD filling the temple. I fell face down.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to me, 'Son of man, pay close attention and carefully observe everything I tell you about the rules and laws of the LORD’s temple. Watch carefully how people enter and leave the sanctuary.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
verses.decoded: Tell the rebellious people of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Enough of all your disgusting sins!'

verses.kjv: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
verses.decoded: You have allowed outsiders, who are uncircumcised in heart and body, to enter my sanctuary and defile my temple by offering sacrifices. Because of your sins, you have broken my covenant.

verses.kjv: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
verses.decoded: You have not properly cared for my holy things; instead, you appointed your own guards to watch over my sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: The Sovereign LORD says: No outsider, whether uncircumcised in heart or body, may enter my sanctuary—even if they live among the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
verses.decoded: The Levites who abandoned me when Israel turned to idols will be held responsible for their sins.

verses.kjv: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
verses.decoded: However, they will still serve in the temple by guarding the gates and assisting with sacrifices for the people.

verses.kjv: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.decoded: Because they served idols and led Israel into sin, I have sworn against them, declares the LORD, and they will be punished for their sins.

verses.kjv: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.decoded: They will not be allowed to serve as priests or approach my holy things in the Most Holy Place. Instead, they will carry the shame of their sins.

verses.kjv: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
verses.decoded: But I will assign them to be guardians of the temple and to handle its daily operations.

verses.kjv: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
verses.decoded: But the priests from the family of Zadok, who remained faithful when Israel sinned, will be allowed to serve me directly and offer sacrifices.

verses.kjv: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
verses.decoded: They will enter my sanctuary and approach my table to serve me, and they will faithfully carry out their duties.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.decoded: When they enter the inner court gates, they must wear linen clothes; they must not wear wool while serving in the inner court and inside.

verses.kjv: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
verses.decoded: They must wear linen caps on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists; they should not wear anything that makes them sweat.

verses.kjv: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
verses.decoded: When they go out to the outer court where the people are, they must take off their service clothes, leave them in the holy rooms, and put on different clothes; they must not make the people holy by wearing their service garments.

verses.kjv: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
verses.decoded: They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow too long; they should only trim their hair.

verses.kjv: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
verses.decoded: No priest is allowed to drink wine when they enter the inner court to serve.

verses.kjv: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
verses.decoded: Priests must not marry widows or divorced women; they should marry young women from Israel or widows who were previously married to priests.

verses.kjv: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.decoded: They will teach my people the difference between what is holy and what is common, and help them understand what is clean and unclean.

verses.kjv: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
verses.decoded: They will serve as judges in disputes, judging according to my laws; they will obey my laws and rules in all gatherings and keep my Sabbaths holy.

verses.kjv: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.decoded: They must not become ceremonially unclean by touching a dead person, except for close relatives like parents, children, or unmarried siblings.

verses.kjv: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
verses.decoded: After being purified, they must count seven days.

verses.kjv: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: On the day he enters the sanctuary to serve in the inner court, he must offer a sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
verses.decoded: They will receive me as their inheritance; you will not give them land in Israel because I am their inheritance and possession.

verses.kjv: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering: and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.decoded: They will eat the grain offerings, sin offerings, guilt offerings, and all things dedicated in Israel will belong to them.

verses.kjv: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
verses.decoded: The first of all your firstfruits and every offering of all kinds belongs to the priests; you must also give the first portion of your dough so the blessing may rest on your home.

verses.kjv: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.decoded: The priests must not eat anything that has died naturally or been torn apart, whether it is a bird or an animal.

verses.kjv: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
verses.decoded: When you divide the land by lot for inheritance, you must set apart a holy portion of the land as an offering to the LORD. It will measure 25,000 reeds in length and 10,000 reeds in width, and it will be holy all around its borders.

verses.kjv: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
verses.decoded: Within this area, the sanctuary itself will be a square measuring 500 by 500 units, with an additional 50 cubits of open space surrounding it.

verses.kjv: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
verses.decoded: You will measure the land to be 25,000 units long and 10,000 units wide, and within it will be the sanctuary and the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The holy portion of the land will be given to the priests who serve in the sanctuary; it will be their place to live and a sacred area for the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
verses.decoded: The Levites, who serve in the temple, will also receive land measuring 25,000 by 10,000 units, which will include twenty chambers for their use.

verses.kjv: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
verses.decoded: The city will be assigned land measuring 5,000 units wide and 25,000 units long, located opposite the holy portion, and it will belong to all the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
verses.decoded: A portion of land will be given to the prince on both sides of the holy portion and the city’s land, extending from the west border to the east border.

verses.kjv: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.decoded: This land will be the prince’s possession in Israel. My princes will no longer oppress my people, and the remaining land will be distributed to the people of Israel according to their tribes.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: Enough, princes of Israel! Stop violence and theft. Do what is right and just, and stop demanding unfair payments from my people.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.decoded: You must use honest scales, and accurate measures for dry goods (ephah) and liquids (bath).

verses.kjv: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.decoded: The ephah and the bath will be the same size, each equal to one-tenth of a homer, which is the standard measure.

verses.kjv: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.decoded: A shekel will equal twenty gerahs. Your maneh will be twenty, twenty-five, or fifteen shekels.

verses.kjv: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
verses.decoded: This is the offering you must give: one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of barley.

verses.kjv: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
verses.decoded: Regarding the oil offering, you will give one-tenth of a bath from a cor, which equals ten baths, since ten baths make one cor.

verses.kjv: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: You will offer one lamb from every two hundred sheep from the best pastures of Israel as a grain offering, burnt offering, and peace offering to make atonement for them, says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
verses.decoded: Everyone in the land will give this offering for the prince of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall be the prince’s part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: It will be the prince's responsibility to provide burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings during festivals, new moons, Sabbaths, and all special celebrations of Israel. He must prepare sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings to atone for Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the first day of the first month, you must take a young bull without any defects and use it to purify the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.decoded: The priest will take some of the sin offering's blood and put it on the doorposts of the temple, the four corners of the altar's base, and the doorposts of the inner courtyard gate.

verses.kjv: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
verses.decoded: On the seventh day of the month, you will do the same for anyone who sins unintentionally or is unaware, to atone for the temple.

verses.kjv: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.decoded: On the fourteenth day of the first month, you will celebrate Passover, a seven-day festival during which you must eat unleavened bread.

verses.kjv: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: On that day, the prince must prepare a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people living in the land.

verses.kjv: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: During the seven days of the festival, the prince will offer a burnt offering to the LORD each day: seven bulls and seven rams without defects, plus a young goat daily as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
verses.decoded: He will also prepare grain offerings: one ephah for each bull, one ephah for each ram, and a hin of oil for every ephah of grain.

verses.kjv: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
verses.decoded: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, during the seven-day festival, he will do the same offerings—sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, and oil—as before.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: The gate of the inner court facing east will be closed during the six working days, but it will be opened on the Sabbath and on the day of the new moon.

verses.kjv: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.decoded: The prince will enter through the porch of that gate and stand by the gatepost. The priests will prepare his burnt offering and peace offerings, and he will worship at the gate’s entrance. Then he will leave, but the gate will remain open until evening.

verses.kjv: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.decoded: The people of the land will worship at this gate’s entrance before the LORD on Sabbaths and new moon days.

verses.kjv: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
verses.decoded: On the Sabbath, the prince will offer six perfect lambs and one perfect ram as burnt offerings to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.decoded: The grain offering will be one ephah for the ram, and for the lambs as much as he can give, with one hin of oil for each ephah of grain.

verses.kjv: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
verses.decoded: On the new moon day, the offering will be a perfect young bull, six perfect lambs, and a perfect ram.

verses.kjv: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.decoded: He will prepare a grain offering of one ephah for the bull, one ephah for the ram, and as much as he can for the lambs, with one hin of oil for each ephah of grain.

verses.kjv: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.decoded: When the prince enters, he will come in through the porch of that gate and leave the same way.

verses.kjv: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
verses.decoded: When the people come to worship during the special festivals, anyone entering through the north gate will leave through the south gate, and anyone entering through the south gate will leave through the north gate. They will not return the same way they came in but will exit through the opposite gate.

verses.kjv: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
verses.decoded: The prince will enter and exit together with the people.

verses.kjv: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.decoded: During the festivals and special occasions, the grain offering will be one ephah for a bull, one ephah for a ram, and as much as he can give for the lambs, with one hin of oil for each ephah of grain.

verses.kjv: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
verses.decoded: When the prince offers a voluntary burnt or peace offering to the LORD, someone will open the east gate for him. He will prepare his offerings as he does on the Sabbath, then leave, and the gate will be closed after he leaves.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
verses.decoded: You must prepare a daily burnt offering to the LORD: a perfect one-year-old lamb every morning.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Every morning, prepare a grain offering for it: one-sixth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil. This grain offering is a continual, permanent ordinance to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
verses.decoded: This is how they will prepare the lamb, grain offering, and oil every morning as a continual burnt offering.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD says: If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, that gift will become their permanent inheritance.

verses.kjv: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.
verses.decoded: However, if the prince gives a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, it will belong to that servant only until the year of release; after that, it must be returned to the prince. The inheritance remains for his sons.

verses.kjv: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
verses.decoded: The prince must not unfairly take the people's inheritance or force them out of their land; instead, he should provide inheritance for his sons from his own property so that the people are not scattered from their land.

verses.kjv: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
verses.decoded: Then he led me through the side entrance of the gate into the priests' holy rooms facing north, and I saw there was a space on both sides toward the west.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
verses.decoded: He told me, 'This is where the priests will cook the trespass and sin offerings and bake the grain offerings, so they do not carry them out into the outer court and make the people holy.'

verses.kjv: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
verses.decoded: Then he took me out to the outer court and showed me that at each of its four corners there was a smaller courtyard.

verses.kjv: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
verses.decoded: Each of these four corner courtyards measured forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; all four were the same size.

verses.kjv: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
verses.decoded: Around each of these four courtyards was a row of buildings with cooking areas underneath the rows all around.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'These are the places where the temple servants will boil the people's sacrifices.'

verses.kjv: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
verses.decoded: Then he brought me back to the temple entrance, and I saw water flowing out from beneath the threshold of the temple toward the east. The front of the temple faced east, and the water flowed out from under the right side of the temple, near the south side of the altar.

verses.kjv: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.decoded: Then he took me north of the gate and led me around outside to the far gate facing east, and there I saw water flowing out on the right side.

verses.kjv: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
verses.decoded: The man with the measuring line walked eastward and measured 1,000 cubits. Then he led me through the water, which reached only to my ankles.

verses.kjv: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.decoded: He measured another 1,000 cubits and led me through the water, which now reached my knees. Then he measured another 1,000 cubits and led me through again, and the water reached my waist.

verses.kjv: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.decoded: Then he measured another 1,000 cubits, and the water had become a river too deep to cross by foot—it was deep enough to swim in and impossible to cross.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Son of man, have you seen this?' Then he brought me back to the riverbank.

verses.kjv: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.decoded: When I returned, I saw many trees growing along both sides of the riverbank.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.decoded: He told me, 'These waters flow east into the desert and then into the sea. When the water reaches the sea, it will heal and restore it.'

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.decoded: Life will flourish wherever these rivers flow; all living creatures will survive and thrive. There will be many fish because the waters will heal and bring life wherever the river goes.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.decoded: Fishermen will stand along the river from Engedi to Eneglaim, spreading their nets. The fish will be diverse and as numerous as those in the great sea.

verses.kjv: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.decoded: However, the muddy and swampy areas will not be healed; they will remain salty and barren.

verses.kjv: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
