verses.decoded: Along both banks of the river, trees will grow that produce fruit all year round. Their leaves will never wither, and their fruit will not run out. The fruit will provide food, and the leaves will be used for healing.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD says: This will be the boundary for dividing the land among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph will receive two portions.

verses.kjv: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.decoded: Each tribe will inherit its share equally, as I promised your ancestors by oath. This land will be your inheritance.

verses.kjv: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.decoded: This will be the northern boundary of the land: from the Great Sea along the road to Hethlon, continuing to Zedad.

verses.kjv: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.decoded: Hamath, Berothah, and Sibraim, which lie between the borders of Damascus and Hamath; and Hazarhatticon, which is near the region of Hauran.

verses.kjv: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.decoded: The northern boundary will start at Hazarenan by the sea, extending along the border of Damascus and continuing northward to the border of Hamath. This defines the northern side.

verses.kjv: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.decoded: The eastern boundary will be measured starting from Hauran, then Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel along the Jordan River, extending to the eastern sea. This is the eastern side.

verses.kjv: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.decoded: The southern boundary runs southward from Tamar to the waters of Meribah at Kadesh, continuing along the valley to the great sea. This is the southern side.

verses.kjv: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.decoded: The western boundary will be the great sea, extending from the border until opposite Hamath. This is the western side.

verses.kjv: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will divide the land by lot as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners living among you who have children. They will be treated like native-born Israelites and will receive an inheritance among the tribes.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Wherever a foreigner lives among a tribe, that tribe will give him his inheritance, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
verses.decoded: Here are the names of the tribes. Starting from the northern boundary near the road to Hethlon, going toward Hamath, Hazarenan, and the northern border of Damascus, reaching the coast of Hamath—this area marks the eastern and western boundaries for the portion assigned to the tribe of Dan.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
verses.decoded: Next to Dan’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Asher.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
verses.decoded: Next to Asher’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
verses.decoded: Next to Naphtali’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
verses.decoded: Next to Manasseh’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
verses.decoded: Next to Ephraim’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Reuben.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
verses.decoded: Next to Reuben’s border, from east to west, is the land portion assigned to the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.decoded: Next to Judah’s border, from east to west, will be a special land offering measuring 25,000 reeds wide and as long as the other portions. The sanctuary will be located in the center of this land.

verses.kjv: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.decoded: The land set aside as an offering to the LORD will measure 25,000 reeds in length and 10,000 reeds in width.

verses.kjv: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: This holy land offering is for the priests. It will measure 25,000 reeds from north to south and 10,000 reeds from east to west, with the LORD’s sanctuary located in the middle.

verses.kjv: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.decoded: This land will belong to the priests descended from Zadok, who remained faithful and did not stray when the rest of Israel and the Levites did.

verses.kjv: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.decoded: This land offering will be a most holy area for the priests, located next to the land assigned to the Levites.

verses.kjv: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.decoded: Next to the priests’ land, the Levites will have land measuring 25,000 reeds long and 10,000 reeds wide.

verses.kjv: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: They must not sell, trade, or transfer this land because it is holy and dedicated to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: The remaining 5,000 reeds in width, next to the 25,000 reeds, will be ordinary land for the city, its homes, and suburbs. The city will be located in the center of this area.

verses.kjv: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: The measurements will be as follows: the north side will be 4,500 units, the south side 4,500 units, the east side 4,500 units, and the west side 4,500 units.

verses.kjv: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: The outskirts or suburbs of the city will extend 250 units to the north, south, east, and west.

verses.kjv: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.decoded: Beyond the holy portion, there will be 10,000 units extending east and 10,000 units extending west. This land will be next to the holy portion, and its produce will provide food for those who serve the city.

verses.kjv: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: Those who serve the city will come from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.decoded: The entire holy offering area will measure 25,000 by 25,000 units, forming a perfect square together with the city’s land.

verses.kjv: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: The remaining land will belong to the prince, on both sides of the holy offering and the city’s land, opposite the 25,000-unit boundaries on the east and west. This land will be holy, with the sanctuary located in the center.

verses.kjv: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.decoded: Additionally, land taken from the Levites’ portion and the city’s portion, which lie within the prince’s territory between Judah and Benjamin, will also belong to the prince.

verses.kjv: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
verses.decoded: Regarding the other tribes, Benjamin will receive a portion of land stretching from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
verses.decoded: Next to Benjamin’s border, Simeon will receive a portion extending from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
verses.decoded: Next to Simeon’s border, Issachar will receive a portion stretching from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
verses.decoded: Next to Issachar’s border, Zebulun will receive a portion extending from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
verses.decoded: Next to Zebulun’s border, Gad will receive a portion stretching from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
verses.decoded: Along Gad’s southern border, the boundary will run straight from Tamar to the waters of Meribah at Kadesh, and then to the river flowing into the Great Sea.

verses.kjv: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: This is the land you will divide by lot among the tribes of Israel as their inheritance; these are their portions, declares the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.decoded: The city’s exits on the north side will measure 4,500 units.

verses.kjv: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
verses.decoded: The city gates will be named after the tribes of Israel. On the north side, there will be three gates: one for Reuben, one for Judah, and one for Levi.

verses.kjv: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.decoded: On the east side, measuring 4,500 units, there will be three gates: one for Joseph, one for Benjamin, and one for Dan.

verses.kjv: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.decoded: On the south side, also 4,500 units long, there will be three gates: one for Simeon, one for Issachar, and one for Zebulun.

verses.kjv: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.decoded: On the west side, measuring 4,500 units, there will be three gates: one for Gad, one for Asher, and one for Naphtali.

verses.kjv: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
verses.decoded: The city will measure about 18,000 units all around. From that day forward, the city will be called 'The LORD is there' (Jehovah Shammah).
